Across four agents, DetouR improves EM by 4.0 points on 2Wiki and 1.4 on HotpotQA on average. We also find that heavier LLM models struggle with this non-semantic evidence, adding little over these simple selectors or even falling behind. In summary, our work reveals association routes as a cheap complement to semantic routes that current search agents overlook: added as a plug-in, they improve every agent we test, in replay and in live runs, at no extra search or LLM cost.

AI.tldr: DetouR 是一个即插即用模块，复用检索页面自带的超链接形成"关联路径"，以替代近似重复查询并做链感知上下文选择，在不增加检索与 LLM 调用的前提下提升多跳问答准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有多跳问答搜索代理遵循"语义路径"：推断缺失信息并转写为查询，只能触及模型能命名的内容。但决定性页面常未被问题提及，且往往距已检索证据仅一条超链接。实验显示，在相同预算下沿关联路径可达更多金标页面。利用它面临两个挑战：一是在不进行昂贵离线图构建的情况下获得关联结构；二是在阅读器有限上下文中保留链接证据，而基于相关性或融合的选择方法会将其丢弃。
AI.method: 提出 DetouR 插件，复用检索页面返回时携带的链接，不增加搜索或 LLM 调用。包含两部分：1) Link Rerouting：用轻量学习型打分器选择链接页面路径，替换近似重复的查询；2) Chain-aware Context Selection：在这些链接上运行个性化 PageRank，使证据链完整进入阅读器上下文。
AI.result: 在四个代理上，DetouR 平均在 2Wiki 上提升 EM 4.0 点、HotpotQA 提升 1.4 点；在回放与在线运行中均有效（详情未在摘要中细化）。
AI.conclusion: 关联路径是语义路径的低成本补充，被现有搜索代理忽视；作为插件接入可提升所有被测代理，且不产生额外检索或 LLM 成本。此外发现更强的 LLM 难以处理此类非语义证据，相较简单选择器增益有限甚至落后。

title: How ready is the United States commercial building stock for artificial intelligence? A national estimate from energy codes and survey data
comment: 48 pages, 9 figures, 17 tables. HUBS Lab Paper No. 2026-011. Code and data: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23966090
summary: Buildings serve as platforms for artificial intelligence (AI) through the data they generate, but the building stock's readiness as an AI platform has not been assessed. A recent framework measures a building's AI readiness as the share of 76 answer levels, across 31 types of operators' questions, that its recorded data could reach, and has so far been applied only to individual buildings. This study applies it to the 2018 U.S. commercial building stock. It combines 6,436 records of the Commercial Buildings Energy Consumption Survey with ASHRAE 90.1's data requirements, state code adoption, advanced-meter statistics and 45 buildings' knowledge graphs, imputing each building's code edition and data recording. Weighted by floor area, the stock could answer on average 0.145 (95% interval 0.127-0.163) of these answer levels. For 92.0% of floor area its data answer less than half of the questions about current status, and most floor area stays below that mark under every tested assumption about compliance, description and the reference buildings. More than half of what installed equipment could answer is lost in recording, mostly because conventional thermostats store nothing and meters lack interval readings. Readiness rises with size, from 0.073 in buildings of at most 5,000 ft$^2$ to 0.173 at 25,000 ft$^2$ or more. Only 1.6% of floor area was built under a code edition requiring recording, introduced in 90.1-2013 for large buildings. The study gives the first national baseline of commercial-building AI readiness and a public-data method that can be reapplied to each new survey to track the stock.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次对美国商业建筑存量的"AI就绪度"进行全国基线评估：按建筑面积加权，存量平均仅能回答76个答案层级中的0.145（95%区间0.127–0.163），92%的建筑面积对现状类问题的数据可答率不足一半。
AI.motivation: 建筑通过其产生的数据充当AI平台，但建筑存量的AI平台就绪程度从未被评估。既有框架仅应用于单体建筑，缺乏全国尺度的基线，无法判断存量作为AI平台的整体能力及其瓶颈。
AI.method: 采用"AI就绪度"框架（定义为建筑记录数据可达到的76个答案层级占31类运营者问题的比例），将其应用于2018年美国商业建筑存量。融合CBECS的6,436条记录、ASHRAE 90.1数据要求、州规范采纳情况、高级计量统计及45栋建筑的知识图谱，对每栋建筑的规范版本与数据记录情况进行插补，并按建筑面积加权，辅以合规性、描述完备性与参照建筑等多重假设的敏感性分析。
AI.result: 存量加权平均AI就绪度为0.145（95%区间0.127–0.163）；92.0%的建筑面积其数据可回答的现状类问题不足一半，且在各假设下多数面积仍低于该阈值。设备本可提供的信息中逾一半在记录环节丢失，主要因常规温控器不存储数据、电表缺乏区间读数。就绪度随规模上升，≤5,000 ft²为0.073，≥25,000 ft²为0.173。仅1.6%的建筑面积建于要求数据记录的规范版本（90.1-2013针对大型建筑）之下。
AI.conclusion: 研究给出商业建筑AI就绪度的首个全国基线，并提出可复用公共数据、随每次新调查重复实施以追踪存量演变的评估方法；结果表明存量整体AI就绪度低，瓶颈集中于数据记录环节而非设备能力，规范层面的记录要求覆盖极为有限。

title: GRAFT: Cross-Backbone LoRA Reuse for Continual Language and Multimodal Learning
summary: In continual learning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning enables large language models to acquire new capabilities through lightweight adapters such as LoRA, yet the reuse of pretrained adapters is typically restricted to models sharing the same backbone. This limits the transfer of learned capabilities from language models to multimodal models. We propose GRAFT (Generalist Reuse of Adapters via Feature-space Transfer), a framework for cross-backbone LoRA reuse. GRAFT retrieves the most relevant pretrained LoRA adapter from a modality-aware library and maps it into the target backbone through a learned linear bridge between corresponding source and target feature spaces. We evaluate GRAFT on ten Super-NaturalInstructions text tasks, transferring Qwen2.5 LoRAs to Qwen2.5-VL, and five multimodal tasks, where Qwen2.5-VL LoRAs are directly reused. Compared with randomly initialized LoRA adapters, GRAFT improves performance on most evaluated tasks. These results show that GRAFT provides a simple and effective mechanism for reusing learned capabilities across language and multimodal models in continual learning.

AI.tldr: 提出GRAFT框架，通过特征空间线性桥接实现跨骨干网络的LoRA适配器复用，将语言模型（Qwen2.5）的LoRA迁移至多模态模型（Qwen2.5-VL）。
AI.motivation: 参数高效微调（如LoRA）让大模型可持续学习新能力，但预训练适配器的复用通常受限于共享同一骨干网络，阻碍了从语言模型到多模态模型的能力迁移。
AI.method: GRAFT包含两步：1）从模态感知的适配器库中检索最相关的预训练LoRA；2）通过学习到的源-目标特征空间之间的线性桥（linear bridge），将适配器映射到目标骨干。
AI.result: 在十个Super-NaturalInstructions文本任务上（Qwen2.5 LoRA→Qwen2.5-VL）及五个多模态任务上（直接复用Qwen2.5-VL LoRA）评估，与随机初始化LoRA相比，GRAFT在多数任务上性能更优。
AI.conclusion: GRAFT为持续学习中跨语言与多模态模型复用已学能力提供了简单有效的机制。

title: SpecRelay: Amortize or Avoid the Round Trip in Edge-Cloud Speculative Decoding
summary: Edge-cloud speculative decoding moves autoregressive drafting to an edge device while a larger cloud model verifies draft tokens in parallel, so that edge drafting and cloud verification overlap under a synchronous draft-verify schedule. Beyond low-latency local networks, however, the next verification request of that schedule can be sent only after the previous reply arrives, so every round still waits out a full round trip, and throughput falls as the network RTT grows. To recover this loss, we present SpecRelay, an edge-cloud LLM inference system that addresses this cost at two levels: it amortizes round trips when cloud verification is necessary and avoids them when local reasoning suffices. For cloud-bound queries, an asynchronous verification pipeline keeps fixed-budget draft trees in flight while earlier replies are still outstanding, and the cloud rejects stale requests before the target-model forward pass (the asynchronous schedule). At the query level, an RTT-conditioned router (the Latency-Aware Router) estimates quality and completion latency for three on-device modes (direct generation, Chain-of-Draft, and full reasoning) and cloud speculative decoding, selecting among them under a configurable accuracy-latency objective without adding latency during inference, since the router runs concurrently with the draft-model prefill. The asynchronous schedule alone improves decoding throughput by up to 50% over a reproduced synchronous baseline across multiple benchmarks. At matched target-model accuracy and 250 ms of added round-trip latency, the full system with the router delivers 1.95x and 1.55x the throughput of the same baseline on SPROUT and OlympiadBench, respectively, while sending only 47% and 39% of the queries to the cloud.

AI.tldr: SpecRelay 是一个边云 LLM 推理系统，通过异步验证流水线与 RTT 感知路由器，消除同步草稿-验证调度中的逐轮往返等待，在高 RTT 下显著提升吞吐。
AI.motivation: 边云投机解码的同步调度中，下一轮验证请求必须等上一轮回复到达才能发送，因此每轮都要等待完整 RTT；网络 RTT 增大时吞吐随之下降。作者希望在不牺牲目标模型精度的前提下回收这部分损失。
AI.method: 在两个层面处理往返代价：(1) 云端验证必要时摊销 RTT——采用异步验证流水线，在先前回复尚未返回时保持固定预算的草稿树在途，云端在前向计算前先拒绝过期请求（异步调度）；(2) 本地推理足够时避免 RTT——Latency-Aware Router 依据 RTT 条件，在三种端侧模式（直接生成、Chain-of-Draft、完整推理）与云端投机解码之间，按可配置的精度-时延目标选择模式；路由器与草稿模型预填充并发执行，不引入额外推理时延。
AI.result: 仅异步调度在多个基准上相比复现的同步基线将解码吞吐提升最高 50%。在目标模型精度匹配、额外 250 ms 往返时延下，完整系统在 SPROUT 与 OlympiadBench 上分别达到基线 1.95x 和 1.55x 的吞吐，同时仅将 47% 和 39% 的查询发送至云端。
AI.conclusion: 通过异步验证流水线摊销往返开销、结合 RTT 感知路由在端侧与云端之间自适应分配查询，可在高 RTT 网络下有效恢复边云投机解码的吞吐损失，且不损失目标模型精度。

title: Take a Step Back: A Dual-Granularity Raw Feature Empowered Intermediate Fusion Graph Convolutional Network for Multimodal Recommendation
summary: Although multimodal recommendations have shown the ability to learn user preferences and item properties by leveraging explicit multimodal information, they remain constrained by two critical limitations: low-quality representation learning and modality fusion. For the former, existing solutions primarily focus on multi-granularity representation learning; however, we argue that training such representations is difficult due to the inherent data sparsity problem in recommendation scenarios. For the latter, existing solutions often rely on contrastive learning to align representations of different modalities to facilitate modality fusion, yet alignment-only objectives may over-compress valuable modality-specific information. To this end, we suggest \underline{``Take a Step Back"} and propose a \textbf{D}ual-granularity raw feature empowered \textbf{I}ntermediate fusion \textbf{G}raph \textbf{C}onvolutional \textbf{N}etwork (\textbf{DIGCN}) for multimodal recommendation. DIGCN leverages the multimodal understanding capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) to construct dual-granularity raw features directly. Furthermore, DIGCN introduces an intermediate fusion graph convolutional network equipped with dynamic cross-modality weight correction, designed to capture cross-modality signals and achieve effective modality fusion. Comprehensive experiments on four real-world datasets validate that DIGCN consistently outperforms a variety of strong baselines. Additional analyses confirm its superiority under varying levels of data sparsity and cold-start scenarios. Notably, DIGCN demonstrates high extensibility, capable of further benefiting from additional contrastive learning-based alignment tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出DIGCN：借助LLM直接构建双粒度原始特征，并用带动态跨模态权重校正的中间融合图卷积网络进行多模态推荐，缓解表征学习的数据稀疏问题与对齐式融合的信息过压缩问题。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态推荐存在两大局限：(1) 表征学习质量低——主流做法追求多粒度表征，但推荐场景数据稀疏，此类表征难以训练；(2) 模态融合不足——现有方法依赖对比学习对齐不同模态表征，然而仅对齐目标会过度压缩有价值的模态特有信息。
AI.method: "退一步"思路：利用LLM的多模态理解能力直接构造双粒度原始特征（dual-granularity raw features），绕开稀疏数据下的表征训练难题；同时设计中间融合图卷积网络（intermediate fusion GCN），并引入动态跨模态权重校正（dynamic cross-modality weight correction）以捕捉跨模态信号、实现有效融合。
AI.result: 在四个真实数据集上全面实验，DIGCN稳定优于多种强基线；额外分析显示其在不同数据稀疏程度与冷启动场景下均具优势；并具备高可扩展性，可进一步从额外的对比学习对齐任务中获益。
AI.conclusion: 以LLM生成的原始特征替代难以训练的细粒度表征、以中间融合替代对齐主导的融合，是提升多模态推荐的有效路径，且在稀疏与冷启动条件下更具鲁棒性与扩展性。

title: Can AI Judge You? An Empirical Audit of Deployment Readiness in LLM-assisted Hiring Systems
summary: Delegating resume screening to large language models (LLMs) requires organizations to establish whether they can distinguish candidates by relevant qualifications while allowing only authorized users to change screening rules or approve exceptions. To this end, we develop a system architecture that separates candidate evidence, evaluation, permission controls, and assessment record, and empirically examine two complementary dimensions of its deployment readiness. First, we assess its operational readiness on four LLMs using a controlled experiment on 210 resumes across 14 job roles and six decision interfaces. Second, we assess its compliance readiness by testing how it handles unauthorized user requests and instructions embedded in resumes. We find that operational performance depends on the choice of evaluation interface: scalar scores generally distinguish qualification changes better than simple pass/fail judgments, while comparative judgments are sensitive to presentation order. Explicit permission rules and separation of resume content from instructions reduce unauthorized compliance, to a varying degree of effectiveness across LLMs and usage contexts. Finally, we find that LLM evaluators often diverge between their decisions and offered justifications. Going beyond simply evaluating LLMs for hiring tasks, our framework supports an audit of a fully configured resume evaluation system to enable its deployment decision.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种将候选人证据、评估、权限控制与评估记录相分离的简历筛选系统架构，并从运行就绪度与合规就绪度两个维度实证检验LLM评估器能否可靠区分候选人资质且仅允许授权用户修改规则；发现标量评分优于简单通过/不通过判断、比较判断对呈现顺序敏感、显式权限规则与内容/指令分离可降低未授权遵从，且LLM决策常与其给出的理由不一致。
AI.motivation: 将简历筛选委托给LLM，组织必须能确认两件事：系统能否依据相关资质区分候选人，以及是否只有授权用户才能修改筛选规则或批准例外。已有工作多停留在评测LLM本身，缺乏对完整配置系统的部署性审计。
AI.method: 设计分离候选人证据、评估、权限控制与评估记录的系统架构；运行就绪度：在210份简历、14个岗位角色、6种决策界面上对4个LLM开展控制实验；合规就绪度：测试系统对未授权用户请求及简历中嵌入指令的响应。
AI.result: 运行性能取决于评估界面选择：标量评分对资质变化的区分能力总体优于简单通过/不通过判断，比较判断对呈现顺序敏感；显式权限规则与简历内容同指令分离可降低未授权遵从，但效果随模型与使用情境而异；LLM评估器的决策与其给出的理由经常不一致。
AI.conclusion: 该框架不止于评测LLM的招聘任务表现，而是支持对完整配置的简历评估系统进行审计，从而为部署决策提供依据。

title: SynthDCB: World Distillation for Scalable Device Control Benchmarking
comment: 65 pages, 7 figures, 17 tables. Details and access are available at: https://github.com/X-LANCE/SynthDCB
summary: Scaling device-control evaluation requires scaling both the worlds agents interact with and the tasks they must solve. We introduce SynthDCB, a scalable benchmark for environment awareness and device control built through world distillation. World distillation transforms knowledge of device behaviors, interaction constraints, and environmental effects into modular executable components, which are composed into interactive worlds with explicit states, actions, and temporal dynamics. A unified capability representation connects tool discovery, world execution, and task synthesis, allowing new capabilities to enter evaluation through a shared construction pipeline. SynthDCB instantiates Home, Car, and Phone domains with 114 device classes, 1,166 functions, and 95 events, supporting five task families with 32 subtypes. The stateful design enables task validation and agent evaluation through state correctness and tool-call traces. We evaluate seven models on 2,560 test tasks; the best achieves 68.2% Pass@1. Error analysis reveals challenges in answer delivery, feasibility diagnosis, and temporal coordination. Construction experiments demonstrate scalability across domains and token efficiency: world distillation reduces token consumption by 0.9-66.0% and 46.2-92.5% relative to Codex with low and xhigh reasoning effort, respectively, while achieving broader capability coverage. SynthDCB makes executable world construction the basis of scalable device-control benchmarking, connecting an expanding space of capabilities and interactions to verifiable agent evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出SynthDCB，通过"世界蒸馏"构建可扩展的装置控制基准。
AI.motivation: 装置控制评测的规模化需要同时扩展交互世界与任务，现有基准难以兼顾。
AI.method: 将设备行为、交互约束与环境效应知识蒸馏为模块化可执行组件，组合成具显式状态、动作与时间动态的交互世界；用统一能力表示连接工具发现、世界执行与任务合成。覆盖Home/Car/Phone三域，114设备类、1166函数、95事件，5类任务族32子类型；基于状态正确性与工具调用轨迹验证和评测。
AI.result: 7个模型在2560测试任务上评测，最佳Pass@1为68.2%；错误集中于答案交付、可行性诊断与时间协调。构建实验显示世界蒸馏相比Codex低/高推理努力token消耗分别降低0.9–66.0%与46.2–92.5%，且能力覆盖更广。
AI.conclusion: SynthDCB以可执行世界构建为基础，将不断扩展的能力与交互空间连接到可验证的智能体评测。

title: Three Invisible Failure Modes in Speech-Based Age Estimation for Child Safety
comment: Non-archival poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Child Safety in AI
summary: Child safety in AI depends on the accurate identification of minor users. Young children tend to talk rather than type when interacting with AI, so in practice this identification requires predicting age from speech. We evaluated whether three audio-capable large language models can predict a child's age from their speech across five studies using two speech corpora of children under the age of 13. Models classified children as over 13 on 2.5% to 42.5% of audio responses, and every model that answered placed some 5- to 11-year-olds over 18. While measuring these rates, we uncovered three distinct failure modes. A client library silently double-encoded speech samples, leading one model to classify children aged 5 to 10 years old as being in their thirties and forties with hallucinated explanations. A second model's endpoint was replaced by a successor that refused nearly every age-related question and never produced an age. Every model sometimes placed the same speech sample under 13 and over 18 years of age, but a third model went further, giving threshold answers that contradicted its own numeric estimates. None of these failure modes produced a warning, a status code, or a change in output format, so they would all pass standard monitoring. These results demonstrate why child-safety claims about age assurance should be evaluated at the level of the pipeline rather than the model. We describe the reporting practices that would make such failures detectable.

AI.tldr: 评估三款音频大模型从儿童语音预测年龄的可靠性，发现误判率高（2.5%–42.5%儿童被判为13岁以上），且存在三种静默失败模式：库双重编码、端点被替换、阈值与数值自相矛盾。
AI.motivation: AI儿童安全依赖准确识别未成年用户；低龄儿童多通过语音而非打字交互，因此年龄保证在实践中归结为语音年龄预测。作者旨在检验音频大模型能否可靠胜任这一安全关键任务。
AI.method: 在五项研究、两个13岁以下儿童语音语料库上评测三款支持音频的大语言模型，统计其将儿童判为13岁以上/18岁以上的比例，并溯源分析观察到的失败原因（客户端库、API端点、输出一致性）。
AI.result: 各模型将2.5%–42.5%的语音回答判为13岁以上，且每个给出答案的模型都把部分5–11岁儿童判为18岁以上。发现三种失败模式：客户端库对语音样本静默双重编码，使模型将5–10岁儿童判为三四十岁并给出幻觉解释；某模型端点被后继版本替换，几乎拒答所有年龄问题、从未输出年龄；某模型给出与自身数值估计矛盾的阈值判断。所有失败均无警告、状态码或输出格式变化，可通过标准监控。
AI.conclusion: 年龄保证的儿童安全声明应在流水线层面而非模型层面评估；作者提出了使此类失败可被检测的报告规范。

title: EchoSpec: Training Search Agents to Weigh Evidence Above Echoes
summary: Search agents trained with reinforcement learning decide what to retrieve, when to search again, and when to answer. In real corpora, one claim is copied and paraphrased across many pages while the primary source settling a question appears once. We show that reinforcement-learned search agents grant echoes the credence of independent sources and lose their ability to abstain. Across five base models from 3B to 32B and seven released RL agents on multi-hop Wikipedia questions with primary evidence intact, eight paraphrased false-claim echoes overturn 58-73% of previously correct answers, while exact-match RL drives deleted-evidence abstention below 15%. Conditioning on retrieval localizes the failure to evidence acquisition: once primary evidence enters context, agents overrule eight echoes as reliably as one, whereas echoes fill top ranks and halt search early, so larger budgets, forced search turns, or passive passage filtering alone fail to recover displaced evidence. We introduce EchoSpec, specifying reliability across five corpus transformations with known target answers and training in two stages. Verification warm-start teaches multi-hop bridge-entity recovery past echoes, after which group RL optimizes an evidence-gated $λ$-reward with an outcome-independent acquisition bonus and scale-preserving advantages retaining the optimal rule $λ/(1+λ)$. Across Qwen2.5-3B, Qwen2.5-7B, and Llama-3.1-8B backbones on nine evaluation suites, EchoSpec cuts eight-echo deference by 30-44 points on Qwen2.5-7B down to 29-31%, nearly quadruples eight-echo reach to 26-27% with zero-shot transfer to unseen BGE and BM25 retrievers, and raises standalone QA precision to 47-55%. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/unihsy/EchoSpec.

AI.tldr: 强化学习搜索智能体存在"回声服从"缺陷：把大量重复的释义性虚假声明当作独立证据，并丧失弃答能力；论文提出 EchoSpec 两阶段训练方法加以修复。
AI.motivation: 真实语料中，同一主张被复制、改写在大量页面上（回声），而真正能定论问题的一次性原始来源往往只出现一次。现有 RL 搜索智能体对回声与独立来源赋予同等可信度，且弃答能力退化，导致原本正确的答案被推翻、检索被回声占据而提前终止。
AI.method: 先做失效诊断：在 5 个 3B–32B 基座模型与 7 个已发布 RL 智能体上，构造含原始证据的多跳维基问答，注入 8 条释义虚假声明回声；并通过"以检索为条件"的消融把失败定位到证据获取阶段。方法为 EchoSpec：(1) 规范在 5 种语料变换下的可靠性，目标答案已知；(2) 两阶段训练——验证式热启动学习越过回声进行多跳桥接实体恢复，随后用 group RL 优化证据门控的 λ 奖励，含与结果无关的获取奖励项与保尺度优势，保留最优决策规则 λ/(1+λ)。
AI.result: 8 条回声可推翻 58–73% 原本正确的答案；精确匹配式 RL 使"证据被删除时弃答"比例低于 15%。增大搜索预算、强制检索轮次或被动过滤段落均无法找回被挤出的证据；而一旦原始证据进入上下文，智能体能像对待单一来源一样推翻 8 条回声，说明瓶颈在证据获取。EchoSpec 在 Qwen2.5-3B/7B 与 Llama-3.1-8B、9 个评测集上，使 Qwen2.5-7B 的八回声服从率下降 30–44 个百分点至 29–31%，八回声触达率近乎翻四倍达 26–27%，并可零样本迁移到未见过的 BGE 与 BM25 检索器，独立问答精度提升至 47–55%。
AI.conclusion: RL 搜索智能体的核心脆弱性在于证据获取而非证据整合：回声污染会同时引发过度采信与弃答丧失。以验证式热启动加证据门控 λ 奖励的两阶段训练可从机制上缓解该问题，并具备跨模型、跨检索器的泛化性。

title: Simulating access to alcohol screening, brief intervention, referral to and receipt of specialty treatment for alcohol use disorder in California and Texas: A study protocol for an agent-based modeling study (AUDTxSim)
summary: Alcohol use disorder (AUD) affects millions of US adults. Primary care-based screening, brief intervention, and referral to treatment (SBIRT) is a leading strategy for identifying heavy drinking early, but access to primary care, screening, and specialty treatment differs markedly across subgroups. Whether scaling SBIRT and expanding treatment capacity narrows or widens these differences is unknown and cannot feasibly be tested in a randomized trial. We present AUDTxSim (AUD Treatment Simulation), a stochastic, spatially explicit, individual-based model of alcohol use, AUD, SBIRT, and specialty treatment for the adult populations of California and Texas. Agents represent every adult in synthetic populations of the two states (28.0 and 19.3 million adults), each geo-located to a Census tract and linked to nearby treatment facilities. In daily time steps, the model simulates: (1) annual transitions among eight alcohol use and AUD states; (2) healthcare visits, screening, brief intervention, and referral; (3) treatment seeking, standalone medication for AUD, mutual help, and requests for hospitalization, residential, or outpatient care; (4) a treatment manager that allocates individuals to facilities by preference, geography, and capacity, with telehealth substitution and waitlists; and (5) treatment progression, stepdown between levels of care, and post-treatment mutual help. It is implemented in Python with Repast4Py to run in parallel on a computing cluster. Once calibrated to state, rural-urban, and demographic targets for healthcare visits, heavy drinking and AUD prevalence, and mortality, AUDTxSim will project population-level and subgroup-specific effects of alternative SBIRT reach and treatment capacity scenarios on AUD prevalence, treatment receipt, and mortality. We report the model structure, decision logic, data sources, and calibration plan.

AI.tldr: AUDTxSim 是一个随机、空间显式、个体为本的模型，模拟加州与德州全部成年人群的酒精使用、AUD、SBIRT 与专科治疗流程，用于评估扩大 SBIRT 覆盖与治疗容量对不同亚群的差异影响。
AI.motivation: 初级保健中的 SBIRT 是早期识别重度饮酒的主要策略，但初级保健可及性、筛查与专科治疗在不同亚群间差异明显；扩大 SBIRT 与治疗容量究竟缩小还是扩大这些差异尚不清楚，且难以通过随机试验检验。
AI.method: 构建 AUDTxSim：以合成人口中每一位成年人（加州 2800 万、德州 1930 万）为个体，按普查区地理定位并关联附近治疗机构；以日为步长模拟八种饮酒/AUD 状态的年度转移、就诊与筛查/简短干预/转诊、求助与治疗类型选择、按偏好-地理-容量分配的治疗管理器（含远程医疗替代与等候名单）、治疗进展与降级及治疗后互助；用 Python 与 Repast4Py 实现并在集群上并行运行。
AI.result: 论文报告模型结构、决策逻辑、数据来源与校准方案；模型将按州、城乡与人口学目标（就诊、重度饮酒与 AUD 患病率、死亡率）校准，进而预测不同 SBIRT 覆盖与治疗容量情景对 AUD 患病率、治疗获得与死亡率的人群层面及亚群层面效应。
AI.conclusion: AUDTxSim 提供了可替代不可行随机试验的计算实验平台，用于量化 SBIRT 扩展与治疗容量变化对酒精使用障碍健康差异的潜在影响。

title: SERAG: SEmantical and Relational approach for Anomaly detection on knowledge Graphs
summary: Knowledge graphs constructed from text can contain facts that are individually plausible yet inconsistent with their relational context. We introduce SERAG, a supervised anomaly detector that combines two complementary plausibility estimates: a semantic score computed from separately encoded subject, relation, and object labels, and a relational score obtained through a relational graph convolutional network. The scores are standardized, calibrated, and fused. We evaluate the method on a subset of ICEWS18 with vocabulary-constrained synthetic anomalies generated by an LLM, using pooled and chronological splits. At 10% anomaly prevalence, SERAG achieves test AUPRCs of 0.321 and 0.258, respectively, compared with 0.159 and 0.146 for the strongest adapted baseline. Fusion improves mean test AUPRC over either branch alone, with a larger gain in the pooled protocol and a smaller validation-selected gain in the chronological protocol. Additional anomaly supervision improves performance. These results support the complementarity of textual and relational signals for detecting synthetic anomalies under the evaluated protocols.

AI.tldr: SERAG：融合语义与关系两种合理性估计的有监督异常检测器，在ICEWS18子集上用LLM生成的词表受约束合成异常评估，10%异常率下测试AUPRC达0.321/0.258，显著优于最强适配基线（0.159/0.146）。
AI.motivation: 文本构建的知识图谱中可能存在单个事实看似合理但与关系语境不一致的异常。单一信号（纯文本语义或纯图结构）难以捕捉这种"局部合理、上下文冲突"的情形，因此需要检验文本语义与关系结构信号是否互补。
AI.method: 提出SERAG有监督异常检测器，融合两类合理性估计：1）语义分数，由分别编码的主语、关系、宾语标签计算得到；2）关系分数，由关系图卷积网络（R-GCN）获得。两分数经标准化、校准后进行融合。数据方面，在ICEWS18子集上使用LLM生成词表受约束的合成异常，并采用汇总式（pooled）与按时间顺序（chronological）两种划分协议进行评估。
AI.result: 在10%异常先验下，SERAG测试AUPRC分别为0.321（pooled）与0.258（chronological），最强适配基线为0.159与0.146。融合相较任一单分支均提升平均测试AUPRC，pooled协议增益更大，chronological协议增益较小且由验证集选定。增加异常监督可进一步提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 在所评估的两种协议下，结果支持文本语义信号与关系结构信号在合成异常检测中的互补性；但结论限定于LLM生成的合成异常与特定数据子集，真实异常场景的泛化性尚待验证。

title: Match and Correct: A Repeated Computational Motif in Evoformer Layers
comment: 27 pages, 4 figures (main text), 16 supplementary figures. NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Interpretability for Discovery. Code: https://github.com/ishankhire/match-and-correct-evoformer
summary: Triangle attention and triangle multiplicative updates form key components of the Evoformer, and were introduced specifically to encourage consistency with the triangle inequality. Yet whether representational changes over layers reduce triangle inequality violations has not been tested. We probe the pair representation at each of OpenFold's 48 Evoformer layers, decoding final C$_α$-C$_α$ distances with four probe families (a shared linear probe, per-protein linear probes, a sequence-separation-gated linear probe, and XGBoost) and reconstructing intermediate 3D structures from the decoded distances via multidimensional scaling. Across a cohort of 552 CAMEO and ECOD proteins, distance decodability ($R^2$) and reconstruction quality (TM-score) rise in early layers, plateau in the middle of the network, and rise again in late layers. Directly measuring triangle-inequality violations in the decoded distances reveals a similar, more exaggerated pattern: violations rise to a peak, fall to a trough, rise to a second peak, and only then decline, revealing two distinct episodes of decreasing normalized triangle violations rather than one continuous improvement. Cumulative forward and reverse layer-wise ablations of the Pair Transition, MSA Transition, and triangle mechanisms localize the regions in which specific Evoformer components become essential. The two stages of geometric refinement coincide with the use of the Pair Transition MLP and the triangle mechanisms. These results characterize how distance information and decoded geometric consistency evolve across layers, and motivate hypotheses about the computations behind their trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文系统探针OpenFold 48层Evoformer的pair表示，解码Cα-Cα距离并重建3D结构，发现距离可解码性与重建质量呈"升-平台-再升"模式，而三角不等式违背量呈"升-降-再升-降"的双峰双谷模式，几何精化存在两个阶段，分别与Pair Transition MLP和三角机制的使用相对应。
AI.motivation: Triangle attention与triangle multiplicative update在Evoformer中被引入以鼓励满足三角不等式，但"层间表示变化是否真的降低了三角不等式违背"从未被验证；本文旨在刻画距离信息与几何一致性在整个Evoformer中的演化轨迹。
AI.method: 对OpenFold 48层Evoformer逐层提取pair表示，用四类探针（共享线性探针、每蛋白线性探针、序列间隔门控线性探针、XGBoost）解码最终Cα-Cα距离，并用MDS由解码距离重建3D结构；在552个CAMEO与ECOD蛋白队列上评估R²与TM-score；直接度量解码距离的归一化三角不等式违背；通过累积式前向与反向逐层消融Pair Transition、MSA Transition及三角机制定位各组件关键区域。
AI.result: 距离可解码性（R²）与重建质量（TM-score）呈早层上升、中层平台、晚层再升的模式；三角不等式违背呈升-降-再升-降的双峰形态，即存在两段独立的归一化违背下降期而非持续改善。逐层消融表明两个几何精化阶段分别与Pair Transition MLP和三角机制的使用相吻合，并定位了各Evoformer组件变得不可或缺的层段。
AI.conclusion: 结果刻画了距离信息与解码几何一致性随层深的演化规律，揭示Evoformer内部存在两阶段几何精化过程，并为解释其背后计算机制提出可检验假设。

title: How did data sharing evolve in the decade since the FAIR Principles?
summary: A decade after the publication of the FAIR Guiding Principles, what have we learned about data sharing, and what do data availability statements (DAS) and other materials accrued over that period tell us about how data-sharing practices, attitudes, and infrastructures evolved? Here, we present a large-scale longitudinal analysis of over 6.8 million biomedical articles from the PMC Open Access Subset, spanning 2011 to 2025. Using an automated pipeline, we extracted and classified DAS, repository links, accession numbers, and supplementary materials, assigning each article a data-sharing score and independently FAIR-assessing a subset of cited dataset URLs. We find that explicit DAS adoption rose from ~2% in 2011 to 68% in 2025, while "available on request" statements grew in parallel from near zero to over 19%. The corpus growth amplifies both patterns: articles with a DAS containing an explicit repository mention rose from 132 in 2011 to 94,697 in 2025, while "available on request" articles rose from 77 to 173,474 over this span. Structural biology and genomics consistently achieved the highest data-sharing scores, while clinical research and public health ranked lowest. Gold Open Access journals showed a small advantage over subscription journals, while Diamond Open Access journals outperformed both. Internationally collaborative articles scored higher than domestic ones. A gender gap emerged: female first-authored articles' scores declined more than male first-authored ones. The analysis further covered additional dimensions, from compliance with funder/journal mandates and JATS XML tagging standards to computational reproducibility signals and the co-occurrence of DAS with ethics statements. A decade on, the gap between declaring data availability and actually sharing machine-readable, reusable data persists across fields, infrastructures and demographics.

AI.tldr: 本文对2011–2025年间PMC开放获取子集中逾680万篇生物医学论文开展大规模纵向分析，用自动化流程抽取并分类数据可用性声明、仓储链接、登录号和补充材料，并给出数据共享评分与FAIR评估，揭示声明与真实共享之间的持续鸿沟。
AI.motivation: FAIR原则发布十年后，学界仍缺乏对数据共享实践、态度与基础设施长期演变的规模化证据；现有研究多为小样本或横断面，难以刻画趋势、学科差异与人口学差异，因此需要基于大规模语料的纵向测量来检验“声明”与“实际共享”的一致性。
AI.method: 构建自动化处理流水线，对PMC开放获取子集2011–2025年超680万篇生物医学文章的全文进行解析，抽取并分类数据可用性声明（DAS）、仓储链接、登录号（accession numbers）与补充材料；为每篇文章计算数据共享评分，并对被引数据集URL的子集独立进行FAIR评估；在此基础上开展跨时间、学科、期刊类型（金色OA、订阅、钻石OA）、国内/国际合作、第一作者性别等维度的比较，并考察资助方/期刊强制政策合规、JATS XML标注规范、计算可复现性信号及DAS与伦理声明的共现。
AI.result: 显式DAS的比例从2011年约2%升至2025年68%；"available on request"表述从近乎为零增至超过19%。含明确仓储提及的DAS文章由2011年132篇增至2025年94,697篇，"available on request"文章由77篇增至173,474篇。结构生物学与基因组学共享评分最高，临床研究与公共卫生最低；金色OA略优于订阅期刊，钻石OA优于两者；国际合作文章高于国内合作；女性第一作者文章的评分降幅大于男性第一作者文章。
AI.conclusion: FAIR原则提出十年后，"声明数据可用"与"真正共享机器可读、可复用数据"之间的差距仍在学科、基础设施与人口学群体中持续存在；政策驱动的DAS普及并未同比例转化为实质性数据共享，需在强制政策、基础设施与元数据规范层面同步改进。

title: Frac-BKT Under Mechanism Scrutiny: Response Assimilation and a Failed Fractional-Memory Test
comment: 9 pages, 1 two-panel figure, 2 tables; includes Appendix A (Idealized L1 Derivation) and Appendix B (Response-Aware Protocol Details)
summary: Long-horizon knowledge tracing requires more than an evocative memory mechanism: the implementation must assimilate observed responses non-anticipatorily, and the mechanism must survive matched controls. We subject Frac-BKT, a BKT-style model with an elapsed-time-scaled truncated fractional history, to both tests. The repaired model predicts response $n$ from a prior mastery state and uses response $n$ only to update the posterior state for later events. A five-seed evaluation uses 676,848 ASSISTments 2017 interactions from 1,694 learners and 19,249 learner--skill trajectories, with chronological 80/10/10 suffix splits. The response-aware model reaches AUC .5860 overall, .5638 after gaps of at least 30 minutes, and .5668 after at least 14 days. Relative to the earlier non-response implementation, the gains are .0473, .0316, and .0277 AUC, respectively. However, the fractional mechanism gate fails: the full model is not better than the matched $α=1$ control and is worse than the matched $τ=0$ control by .0090 AUC on both long-gap slices. Student-cluster wild-bootstrap intervals exclude zero, both Holm-adjusted $p$-values are .00006, and all five per-seed differences favor $τ=0$. Compact AKT-, SAKT-, and DAS3H-style references also remain stronger on long gaps. The contribution is therefore a response-assimilation repair and a falsifiable audit showing that response assimilation helps while the evaluated fractional-history term does not---not a state-of-the-art or causal-retention claim.

AI.tldr: 本文修复了Frac-BKT的响应同化缺陷（用响应n只更新后续状态），但严格对照检验表明其分数阶历史机制未通过闸门检验，贡献在于修复与可伪造性审计而非SOTA。
AI.motivation: 长时程知识追踪不仅需要"有表现力"的记忆机制：实现上必须非预期性地同化观测响应，且机制须能通过匹配对照检验。作者质疑已有Frac-BKT实现可能存在响应泄漏并在缺少匹配对照下宣称机制有效。
AI.method: 对带经过时间缩放截断分数阶历史的BKT式模型Frac-BKT做两项检验：(1) 修复为用响应n之前的掌握状态预测响应n，响应n仅用于更新后验状态；(2) 设置匹配对照（α=1全模型、τ=0对照）。数据为ASSISTments 2017的676,848条交互、1,694名学习者、19,249条学习者—技能轨迹，按时间顺序80/10/10后缀切分，五随机种子评估；采用学生簇wild bootstrap及Holm校正，并与AKT、SAKT、DAS3H式紧凑参考模型比较。
AI.result: 响应感知模型总体AUC .5860，≥30分钟间隔后.5638，≥14天后.5668；相对原非响应实现分别提升.0473、.0316、.0277。但分数阶机制闸门失败：全模型不优于匹配α=1对照，且在两个长间隔切片上比τ=0对照低.0090 AUC；bootstrap区间排除零，两Holm校正p值均为.00006，五个种子差异全部偏向τ=0。紧凑AKT/SAKT/DAS3H参考在长间隔上仍更强。
AI.conclusion: 贡献是响应同化修复与可伪造性审计：响应同化有益，而被评估的分数阶历史项无效；作者明确不作SOTA或因果保持性声明，并提示同类宣称需经非预期性实现与匹配对照双重检验。

title: HIMX: mixed-format matrix multiplication based on customized HIFLOAT4 representations
summary: 4-bit weight-activation quantization (W4A4) is an important approach for efficient large language model (LLM) inference. Recent hierarchical formats such as HiFloat4 (HIF4) improve the representational range of 4-bit quantization through multi-level scaling. However, the same local mantissa representation in HIF4 may not be equally suitable for weights and activations, which exhibit distinct distribution characteristics. To address this limitation, we propose HiMX, a mixed-mantissa framework built upon the hierarchical scaling structure of HIF4. Our key observation is that the two HIF4-compatible mantissa representations, S1P2 and E2M1, exhibit complementary quantization behavior: the denser S1P2 format provides higher resolution for concentrated weight distributions, while the wider-spaced E2M1 format provides complementary quantization characteristics for activation tensors. HiMX enables operand-tailored mantissa representations while converting heterogeneous mantissas into fixed-point integer operands with operand-specific widths, allowing different operand formats to share a unified integer multiply-accumulate (MAC) array. Block-level analysis on Qwen3-8B shows that HIF4-S1P2 is better suited for weights while HIF4 E2M1 is better suited for activations, and their mixed-format combination achieves lower output MSE than homogeneous configurations. Across multiple benchmarks, HiMX reduces the average end-to-end accuracy loss from 2.38 to 1.77 points on Qwen3-8B and from 2.23 to 1.85 points on Qwen3-30B-A3B, demonstrating the potential benefit of heterogeneous mantissa representations for W4A4 LLM inference.

AI.tldr: 提出HiMX混合尾数框架，在HIF4分层缩放结构上为权重选用S1P2、为激活选用E2M1尾数表示，并将异构尾数转为不同位宽定点整数以共享统一MAC阵列，显著降低W4A4 LLM推理精度损失。
AI.motivation: W4A4量化对LLM高效推理意义重大，HIF4等分层格式通过多级缩放扩展了4-bit表示范围，但HIF4中统一的局部尾数表示难以同时适配分布差异明显的权重与激活。
AI.method: 基于HIF4分层缩放结构构建混合尾数框架HiMX：利用两种HIF4兼容尾数表示S1P2与E2M1的互补特性，权重采用更密集的S1P2以获得更高分辨率，激活采用间距更大的E2M1；并将异构尾数转换为操作数特定宽度的定点整数，使不同操作数格式共享统一整数乘累加（MAC）阵列。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B的块级分析中，HIF4-S1P2更适合权重、E2M1更适合激活，混合格式组合的输出MSE低于同构配置；多基准测试中，Qwen3-8B平均端到端精度损失由2.38降至1.77个百分点，Qwen3-30B-A3B由2.23降至1.85个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 异质尾数表示可为W4A4 LLM推理带来实际收益，HiMX在保持统一整数MAC硬件的前提下实现了操作数定制的尾数格式并降低量化精度损失。

title: Large Language Models for AI Infrastructure
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to design, optimize, and operate the infrastructure behind AI training and serving, yet the literature remains fragmented across hardware design, machine learning systems, electronic design automation, and high-performance computing. We present a comprehensive survey of LLM-assisted AI infrastructure across its lifecycle, from accelerator design and kernel engineering to compilation, deployment, operations, data management, and energy optimization. We organize the literature by the primary resource the LLM manages: artifact-centric methods for computational artifacts, operational-centric methods for deployment context and system state, and resource-centric methods for data and energy. These categories span the lifecycle and cover AI-specific concerns such as distributed-training configuration, inference serving, GPU-cluster scheduling, and data loading. Building on this taxonomy, we conduct a cross-study quantitative synthesis of reported results. Because studies adopt heterogeneous benchmarks, baselines, hardware, and metrics, we compare methods only where evaluation conditions permit and align results along common dimensions: functional correctness, execution performance, throughput, resource and energy consumption, operational outcomes, and optimization cost, keeping each result's native metric, baseline, and setting rather than collapsing them into a single score. This comparison reveals where LLM-driven methods yield consistent gains, how reported gains in workload orchestration depend on the evaluation environment, from simulators to real clusters and production, and where evidence is still lacking. Together, the taxonomy, lifecycle perspective, and quantitative evaluation provide an evidence-grounded reference for LLM-driven engineering of AI infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文是LLM辅助AI基础设施领域的综述，按LLM所管理的资源类型提出"工件中心/运维中心/资源中心"三层分类法，并做跨研究的定量综合，在保持各结果原生指标与基线的条件下对齐对比，指出LLM方法在何处有一致收益、收益如何依赖评测环境、以及证据缺口。
AI.motivation: LLM已广泛用于AI训练与推理基础设施的设计、优化与运维，但相关文献分散在硬件设计、机器学习系统、电子设计自动化与高性能计算等多个社区，缺乏统一视角与证据汇总。
AI.method: 以生命周期为线索组织文献（加速器设计、算子/内核工程、编译、部署、运维、数据管理、能耗优化），提出按LLM管理的主要资源划分的分类法：面向计算工件的artifact-centric方法、面向部署上下文与系统状态的operational-centric方法、面向数据与能源的resource-centric方法；并在此基础上进行跨研究定量综合，仅在评测条件可比处比较，沿功能正确性、执行性能、吞吐、资源与能耗、运维结果、优化成本等共同维度对齐，保留各结果的原始指标、基线与设置而不合并为单一分数。
AI.result: 识别出LLM驱动方法具有一致收益的环节；揭示工作负载编排类收益对评测环境（模拟器、真实集群、生产环境）的依赖程度；并定位现有证据仍不足的方向。
AI.conclusion: 该综述通过分类法、生命周期视角与定量评测，为LLM驱动的AI基础设施工程提供了有证据支撑的参考框架。

title: Straight to the Product: What Online Retailers Miss When Shoppers Ask AI First
summary:
When people ask an AI assistant what to buy, what happens next at the store? We link the same people's assistant conversations to their later browsing at twenty large online retailers. People go to the product the assistant named: among shoppers who had not visited the store in the past week, visits to the named product within a day rise from 0.02 to 2.07 per 100 answers (+2.0 points [1.7, 2.4]), and on days with a product-page visit at the store, 44% show a product from their own answer, against 1.5% for a matched answer given to someone else. The result replicates in a separate five-month period. Few arrive through the assistant's link: 89% of visits carry no sign of it, and 54% follow a web search, the same share as their usual visits. When a search comes just before the first visit, it names the answer's product 28% of the time (1% in earlier weeks), as if the search box were an address bar. The chat names the product; the store logs a search. Once there, shoppers keep browsing.
  We propose product follow-through, the share of answers followed by a visit to the product they named, as a way to evaluate shopping assistants and agents by what people do next: it needs no referral data or provider logs and can be computed for each assistant.

AI.tldr: 论文将同一用户的AI助手对话与其在20家大型零售商的后续浏览行为相链接，提出"产品跟进率"（product follow-through）作为评估购物助手的新指标，发现用户会显著转而访问助手推荐的具体商品，但多数并未通过助手链接进入，而是经由网页搜索等路径，呈现出"对话点名、商店记录搜索"的分离现象。
AI.motivation: 现有对购物型AI助手/代理的评估缺少基于用户真实后续行为的度量，且依赖推荐归因数据或服务商日志，难以跨助手比较。作者希望回答"人们向助手问买什么之后，到商店里实际发生了什么"，并给出一套不依赖推荐链路追踪的、可对每个助手计算的评估指标。
AI.method: 采用个体层面数据链接：将同一批用户的助手对话与他们在20家大型在线零售商的后续浏览行为相匹配。以"近期未访问该商店"的购物者为基准人群，测量收到回答后一天内对回答所点名商品的访问率（每100条回答），并将用户自身的回答与"匹配的他人回答"作为对照。另用独立五个月时段做重复验证；同时分析访问是否经由助手链接、是否伴随网页搜索及其查询内容，并考察进入后的继续浏览行为。
AI.result: 基准人群中对被点名商品的次日访问率由0.02升至每100条回答2.07次（+2.0个百分点，置信区间[1.7, 2.4]）；在有产品页访问的商店日中，44%出现来自其本人回答的商品，而他人匹配回答仅1.5%，差异显著；结果在独立五个月时段中复现。89%的访问不带助手链接痕迹，54%经由网页搜索（与其日常访问比例相同）。在首次访问前紧邻出现搜索时，该搜索28%的情况下点名了回答中的商品（此前数周仅1%），提示搜索框被当作地址栏使用。
AI.conclusion: 购物助手对下游商品访问具有显著且可复现的引导作用，但归因高度隐蔽：对话中"点名"产品，零售端只"记录"一次搜索，传统推荐/点击归因会低估其影响。作者据此提出"产品跟进率"——回答之后出现对所点名商品访问的比例——作为无需推荐数据或服务商日志、可对每个助手逐个计算的评估指标，用于按"人们接下来怎么做"来评价购物助手与代理。

title: Necessary for What? Auditing Demographic Disclosure to LLM Synthetic Respondents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly answer surveys on behalf of real panelists, and each panelist's recorded demographic attributes (e.g., age, education, ethnicity) are often placed in the prompt on the premise that richer profiles make more faithful synthetic respondents. While data minimization limits personal data to what a purpose requires, a synthetic survey serves several purposes at once, from predicting individual answers to estimating how opinions are distributed and comparing groups. We ask which of these purposes require the respondent's record, and whether improved estimates support sound conclusions about groups. We vary whose profile a model receives, where it comes from, and how many fields it contains, in two U.S. surveys with eleven open-weight and three hosted models, and compare each model with a statistical model fit to the same information. We make four contributions. First, we show that the record adds little to individual predictions and that, for the open-weight models, most of its gain in population estimates remains when it is replaced by census data or a synthetic persona. Second, we find that group comparisons improve only with the respondent's own record, and that even then the models' group differences rest more on the demographic label in the prompt than on the individual respondent, which the usual check of reproducing known group differences does not reveal. Third, we find that the models make groups look more alike than they are, keeping differences in circumstances while flattening or reversing differences in attitudes, most sharply for religious affiliation and ethnic origin, both special categories of personal data. Fourth, we outline an audit that a survey organization can run on questions it has already fielded to decide which estimates may use the record.

AI.tldr: 该文系统检验"在提示中放入受访者人口统计记录"这一做法对各调查目的的必要性：个体预测收益很小，总体分布估计可用普查或合成人格替代，仅群体比较需要本人记录且模型仍更依赖提示中的标签；模型还会压平/反转态度层面的群体差异。
AI.motivation: LLM 越来越多被用于代替真实小组成员回答问卷，常见假设是"画像越丰富，合成受访者越忠实"，因此把年龄、教育、族裔等人口属性塞进提示。但数据最小化原则要求个人数据只服务于特定目的，而合成调查同时承担个体答案预测、总体意见分布估计和群体比较等多重目的。作者因此追问：这些目的中哪些真正需要受访者个人记录，以及估计改进是否足以支撑可靠的群体结论。
AI.method: 两项美国调查数据；11 个开放权重模型 + 3 个托管模型。控制三个维度：(1) 模型收到"谁"的画像（本人/他人）、(2) 画像来源（真实记录、普查数据、合成人格）、(3) 字段数量。与拟合于相同信息的统计模型作对照。另设计针对已投放问题的审计流程。
AI.result: (1) 个人记录对个体答案预测增益很小；对开放权重模型，其总体估计增益的绝大部分在替换为普查数据或合成人格后仍保留。(2) 群体比较只在用受访者本人记录时改善，但即便如此，模型给出的组间差异更多来自提示中的人口标签而非个体本人，常规的"复现已知组间差异"检查无法揭示这一点。(3) 模型使群体显得比实际更相似：境况差异得以保留，态度差异被压平甚至反转，在宗教归属与族裔来源上最明显（二者属个人数据特殊类别）。(4) 提出一套可对已投放问题运行的审计，用于判定哪些估计可以使用个人记录。
AI.conclusion: 受访者人口记录对合成调查的必要性被高估：个体预测与总体估计可借普查/合成画像近似达成，而依赖真实记录带来的群体结论存在标签驱动偏差和态度差异扁平化风险。调查机构应以审计取代默认"全画像"配置，按目的决定是否使用个人数据。

title: FedFit: Federated Dynamic Sparse Training via Fisher Information scoring
comment: The paper was accepted by ICML 2026
summary: Cross-device Federated Learning (FL) is frequently bottlenecked by the prohibitive memory and communication costs of training deep neural networks on resource-constrained edge hardware. While federated dynamic sparse training aims to alleviate these costs by adjusting sparse structures during training, existing methods rely on magnitude-based heuristics that are fundamentally ill-suited for the non-convergent, heterogeneous environments inherent to FL. To address this challenge, we propose FedFit, a federated dynamic sparse training framework that replaces simple heuristics with optimization-centric criteria for structure adjustment. By leveraging a second-order approximation of the loss landscape via the Fisher Information Matrix, FedFit enables precise and efficient structure adjustment without the overhead of explicit Hessian computation. Empirical evaluations across computer vision and natural language processing benchmarks demonstrate that FedFit significantly narrows the sparse-to-dense accuracy gap, outperforming state-of-the-art methods while maintaining high communication efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/Serena-28/Fedfit.git .

AI.tldr: 提出FedFit，一种联邦动态稀疏训练框架，用基于Fisher信息矩阵（FIM）的二阶优化准则替代传统的幅度启发式准则来进行稀疏结构剪枝与再生，从而在降低内存与通信开销的同时显著缩小稀疏-稠密精度差距。
AI.motivation: 跨设备联邦学习在资源受限的边缘硬件上训练深度网络时，内存与通信成本过高。现有联邦动态稀疏训练依赖基于幅度的启发式准则，而这类准则本质上不适配FL中非收敛、异构的环境。
AI.method: FedFit以优化为中心的准则替代简单启发式来进行结构调整：利用Fisher信息矩阵对损失曲面做二阶近似，从而实现精确且高效的结构剪枝与再生，且无需显式计算Hessian。
AI.result: 在计算机视觉与自然语言处理基准上的实证评估表明，FedFit显著缩小了稀疏与稠密模型之间的精度差距，在保持高通信效率的同时优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 以二阶优化信息（FIM）驱动的结构调整准则可有效克服幅度启发式在非收敛、异构联邦环境中的局限，是提升联邦动态稀疏训练性能的有效方向。

title: Policy Optimization With Multiple Verifiers via Pareto Rankings
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an important approach to improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models. In tasks such as code generation and instruction following, multiple verifiers evaluate whether a response satisfies different requirements. Their outcomes provide detailed feedback about partial success, yet this feedback is commonly aggregated into a scalar reward for policy optimization. Rewarding only complete success discards distinctions among partial solutions, while counts and weighted sums impose comparisons between responses that satisfy different subsets of requirements. We introduce Partial-Order Likelihood Policy Optimization (POLPO), which learns from the comparisons established by verification without first constructing an aggregate reward. Pareto dominance identifies responses that satisfy additional requirements without losing any already satisfied, while leaving responses with conflicting outcomes incomparable. POLPO extends the listwise likelihood underlying Direct Preference Optimization by maximizing the total probability of all complete rankings consistent with these partial orders. This objective provides supervision from verified improvements even before complete solutions are available, without requiring a prescribed ordering of incomparable responses. Experiments on code generation and instruction following demonstrate improved learning efficiency and higher rates of complete requirement satisfaction compared with scalar-reward training. These results support partial-order likelihood as an effective approach to learning from multiple verifiers.

AI.tldr: 提出 Partial-Order Likelihood Policy Optimization（POLPO），用多验证器的 Pareto 偏序比较代替标量奖励聚合，通过最大化与偏序一致的完整排序的总体似然来优化策略，在代码生成与指令遵循上提升学习效率与完整满足率。
AI.motivation: RLVR 中多个验证器对同一回答是否满足不同要求给出细粒度反馈，但通常被聚合成单一标量奖励用于策略优化。仅奖励完全成功会丢失部分解之间的差异；计数或加权求和则强行比较满足不同要求子集的回答，引入不合理的可比性。
AI.method: POLPO 不先构造聚合奖励，而是直接利用验证产生的比较关系：以 Pareto 支配判定“在不损失已满足要求的前提下满足更多要求”的改进对，冲突结果保持不可比。方法将 DPO 的 listwise 似然推广，最大化与这些偏序一致的所有完整排序的总概率，从而在无完全解时也能获得监督，且无需对不可比回答规定顺序。
AI.result: 在代码生成与指令遵循任务上，与标量奖励训练相比，POLPO 表现出更高的学习效率和更高的完整要求满足率。
AI.conclusion: 偏序似然是从多验证器反馈中学习的一种有效途径，可避免标量聚合带来的信息损失与不当比较。

title: What Unlinked Aggregates Still Prove: Ranker Comparisons from Exact and Differentially Private Item Counts
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures. Accepted for publication in the Privacy and Security of Big Data special session at IEEE BigData 2026. Code available at https://github.com/AnthonyXu109/psbd26-artifact
summary: Privacy controls can prevent an evaluator from linking purchases to the recommendations users received, while a merchant can still release complete item-level purchase counts for the evaluation cohort. We ask when these counts identify which recommender performs better. The counts constrain who could have bought each item. We bound the performance difference over all assignments consistent with the counts. A reduced transportation network handles full catalogs and can certify attainable endpoints. If the interval excludes zero, it identifies the better recommender for that cohort. With differentially private counts, one confidence guarantee applies jointly to all comparisons from the same release. In two e-commerce cohorts of about 20,000 and 100,000 users, exact counts narrowed every interval compared with bounds that ignored the counts. Most decisions involved a recommender that favors popular items. For NDCG@10, which rewards ranking purchased items higher, each setting combined one of three personalized pairs with a pattern and rate of missing links. Exact counts settled 14 of 168 settings in the smaller cohort and none of 81 in the larger cohort. In the smaller cohort, exact counts broken down by user group settled two personalized pairs when 90% of users remained linked, at the cost of revealing more about individual purchases. Whole-cohort private releases with one count per item retained much of the narrowing but settled no personalized pair in either cohort. Grouping less popular items into bins let private counts settle one personalized pair in the smaller cohort.

AI.tldr: 提出用物品级购买计数约束下的性能差区间来判定推荐器优劣，借助简化运输网络求解上下界并给出差分隐私下的联合置信保证；实测中计数缩窄了区间，但仅在小规模队列的少量设置下能做出可靠判定。
AI.motivation: 隐私控制使评估者无法把用户购买与所收到的推荐关联起来，但商家仍可发布评估队列的完整物品级购买计数。论文探究这些计数在何种条件下足以识别哪个推荐器表现更好。
AI.method: 购买计数限制了每件物品的可能购买者集合，据此在所有与计数一致的购买分配上界定推荐器性能差异；构建简化运输网络以处理完整商品目录并证明端点可达；若区间不含零则判定该队列上的更优推荐器；对差分隐私计数给出覆盖同一发布下所有比较的联合置信保证。
AI.result: 在两个约2万与10万用户的电商队列中，精确计数使所有区间较忽略计数的下界更窄；多数判定涉及偏好热门物品的推荐器。NDCG@10下，较小队列168个设置中精确计数判定14个，较大队列81个设置中无一判定；较小队列中90%用户保持关联的分组精确计数判定两个个性化对，但暴露更多个人购买信息；全队列每物品一个计数的私有发布保留了大部分缩窄效果却未判定任何个性化对；将冷门物品分箱后私有计数在较小队列判定一个个性化对。
AI.conclusion: 物品级购买计数能有效缩窄推荐器性能差异区间，但隐私保护下的计数（精确或分箱）实际可判定的个性化比较极为有限，仅在特定小规模队列设置中成立。

title: Who Bears the Excess? Imputing the Acts of AI Agents to Those Who Delegate
summary: When an AI agent acts outside the authority conferred on it, the actor is not a legal subject and the legal subjects did not act. The literature of 2026 agrees that the agent cannot bear responsibility and that the burden falls on those who deploy it, but it leaves open where that duty sits in positive law and how it is proved. This paper proposes a rule of imputation. The excess is imputed to whoever conferred the delegation, to the extent of the perimeter it documented and of the control it actually exercised. Imputation identifies the organisational conduct to be examined first; liability follows only if the requirements of the applicable head of liability are met; and the mode in which the agent left its perimeter determines which facts must be proved, by whom, and with what consequence. The paper distinguishes the declared, configured and effective perimeters, four figures of excess and four modes of exit, and presents the delegation record as the document through which the perimeter and the control can be proved. The rule is illustrated on the OpenAI and Hugging Face incident of July 2026, under European Union law and, as an example of national law, Italian civil law.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一项"归责规则"：AI代理越权行事时，将越权行为归属于授权方，范围以其书面记录的权限边界和实际行使的控制为限，须先确定组织行为，再检验具体责任要件的成立。
AI.motivation: 2026年文献已形成共识——AI代理本人不能承担责任，负担落于部署者；但该义务在实定法中的位置及证明方式仍悬而未决。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 提出归责规则，区分声明边界、配置边界与有效边界，四种越权形态与四种越界方式；以"授权记录"作为证明权限边界与控制程度的文件；并在2026年7月OpenAI与Hugging Face事件上，结合欧盟法与意大利民法进行示例性适用。
AI.result: 归责仅识别应优先审查的组织行为，责任成立仍取决于所适用责任类型的要件是否满足；越界方式决定待证事实、举证主体及法律后果。规则在欧盟法与意大利民法双重框架下得到示例验证。
AI.conclusion: 越权行为的责任应归属于授权方，归属限度取决于其书面记录的权限边界与实际控制；授权记录是权限与控制的可证明载体，越界方式则塑造举证结构。

title: Minari: Infrastructure for Collaborative Reinforcement Learning Datasets
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) depends on shared datasets, but sharing them is still hard. Each benchmark ships its own format, documentation is thin, and most datasets cannot be regenerated once the environment code moves on. We introduce Minari, an open-source Python library for creating, sharing, and loading RL datasets. Its API follows Gymnasium, so recording a dataset means wrapping an environment and stepping through it as usual. From there, users can attach metadata, filter, combine, and shuffle datasets, and publish or download them with one command through the HuggingFace Hub. Every dataset stores the environment specification, seeds, applied wrappers, and pinned package requirements needed to rebuild the environment and regenerate the data. TorchRL, AgileRL, and d3rlpy already load Minari datasets natively, so switching datasets in those libraries takes one line of code. Minari also hosts 338 reproducible datasets (350K trajectories, 55M steps) covering robotic locomotion and manipulation, maze and grid navigation, language-conditioned instruction following, Atari, and web navigation, including a full regeneration of D4RL with public generation scripts. We report baseline scores for six offline RL algorithms on the regenerated D4RL and MuJoCo datasets.

AI.tldr: Minari 是一个开源 Python 库，用于创建、共享与加载离线强化学习数据集，兼容 Gymnasium API，支持一键发布至 HuggingFace Hub，并提供 338 个可复现数据集及六种离线 RL 算法的基线成绩。
AI.motivation: 离线 RL 依赖共享数据集，但当前生态存在三方面痛点：各基准自带格式、文档匮乏；环境代码变更后多数数据集无法重新生成；缺少统一的创建、共享与加载工具链。
AI.method: 提出 Minari：API 遵循 Gymnasium，录制数据只需包装环境并正常步进；支持元数据附加、过滤、合并与打乱；通过 HuggingFace Hub 一条命令完成发布与下载。每个数据集存储环境规格、随机种子、所用 wrapper 及锁定版本依赖，以保证环境可重建与数据可再生。TorchRL、AgileRL、d3rlpy 原生支持加载，切换数据集仅需一行代码。
AI.result: 托管 338 个可复现数据集（35 万条轨迹、5500 万步），覆盖机器人运动与操作、迷宫与网格导航、语言指令跟随、Atari、网页导航等任务，并包含配合公开生成脚本的 D4RL 完整复现；报告了六种离线 RL 算法在复现版 D4RL 与 MuJoCo 数据集上的基线成绩。
AI.conclusion: Minari 为离线 RL 数据集提供了标准化、可复现的创建—共享—加载基础设施，降低了数据集使用与跨库迁移成本，并通过可复现基准与基线结果为后续研究提供可靠比较基础。

title: Assume/Guarantee Contracts for the Compositional Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning of Heterogeneous Teams
summary: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) problems for heterogeneous teams require agents to collaborate to complete team tasks while making the best use of diverse agent capabilities. We introduce assume/guarantee contracts for heterogeneous multi-agent systems (AGC-MAS) and Iterative Heterogeneous Assignment for MARL (IHA-MARL). AGC-MAS contracts are compositional objects that encode the assumptions provided to, and the guarantees required of, each subtask contributing to the overall team task. We formulate contracts as tuples that specify a subtask, an automaton, timeout and success-probability requirements, and dispatch behavior. The automaton tracks an agent's high-level progress through the subtask associated with its contract and provides a natural mechanism for synchronization across contracts. Our abstraction enables robust interaction across heterogeneous low-level subtask implementations, allows heterogeneous agents to substitute for one another in satisfying contracts, and supports reuse of previously satisfied contracts in new team contexts. Having defined our theoretical framework, we develop a decomposition algorithm that breaks down a team task into a set of contracts. We then propose an iterative algorithm for task assignment and MARL that alternates between assigning contracts representing subtasks to individual agents, training the assigned agents to satisfy their contracts, and assessing their resulting capabilities to inform the next round of task assignments until the team's success probability meets the desired threshold. Our experimental results demonstrate the versatility of contracts in enabling agent substitution and contract reuse. Across three benchmarks with five seeds each, IHA-MARL achieves observed $100\%$ final evaluation success. In CPU timing pilots, comparable baselines required approximately $7$--$11\times$ more training-loop time.

AI.tldr: 提出面向异构多智能体强化学习的assume/guarantee契约框架AGC-MAS及迭代任务分配算法IHA-MARL，实现契约分解、异构替代与重用，并在三个基准上达100%最终成功率。
AI.motivation: 异构团队MARL需在协作完成团队任务的同时充分利用各智能体的差异化能力，但缺乏可组合、可同步、可复用的任务抽象机制，导致任务分配与能力评估难以衔接。
AI.method: 将契约形式化为元组（子任务、自动机、超时与成功概率要求、调度行为），自动机刻画智能体在子任务中的高层进度并实现跨契约同步；给出把团队任务分解为契约集合的分解算法；提出IHA-MARL，在“契约分配给个体—训练其满足契约—评估能力反馈下一轮分配”之间迭代直至团队成功概率达阈值。
AI.result: 实验验证契约支持智能体替代与契约重用；三个基准各五个随机种子的实验中，IHA-MARL最终评估成功率达100%；CPU计时试点中，可比基线训练循环耗时约为其7–11倍。
AI.conclusion: 契约抽象为异构低层实现的鲁棒交互提供统一接口，使智能体可互换并复用已满足契约；迭代分配与能力评估闭环显著提升团队成功率并降低训练开销。

title: Overview of the Plagiarism Detection Task at PAN 2026
comment: Corrected version of the paper published in CEUR-WS Vol-4283: an error in the one-shot generation dataset was fixed and the one-shot results (Sec. 2.3, Table 3, Figs. 2, 3, 6) were updated; the sequential dataset and its results are unchanged. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23528623 (Version v3)
summary: The generative plagiarism detection task at PAN 2026 aims at retrieving the original scientific sources for given automatically generated textual plagiarism. We created two novel datasets of synthetically generated plagiarism following the premise of a malicious actor trying to generate papers with minimal effort while evading detection of undisclosed re-use. We utilized four widely available LLMs: GPT-OSS 120B, Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen 3.5 27B FP8, and DeepSeek-R1 Distill Llama 8B. In this task overview paper, we outline the creation of this dataset and summarize and compare the results of all participants with three baselines. For this year's task, we received 26 submissions from six teams that significantly outperformed our baselines.

AI.tldr: PAN 2026 生成式抄袭检测任务：构建两个合成生成抄袭数据集，用四个开源 LLM 生成对抗性改写文本，26 支队伍提交系统显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 恶意行为者可能用最少精力借助 LLM 生成论文以规避未披露复用的检测，需要专门任务与数据集来评估检测系统在生成式抄袭场景下的检索能力。
AI.method: 以"低投入生成、规避检测"为威胁模型，使用 GPT-OSS 120B、Llama 3.1 8B、Qwen 3.5 27B FP8、DeepSeek-R1 Distill Llama 8B 四个广泛可得的 LLM 合成生成抄袭文本，构建两个新数据集；任务形式为给定生成抄袭片段检索原始科学来源，并设置三个基线系统用于对比。
AI.result: 共收到来自 6 支队伍的 26 个提交，所有提交均显著优于三个基线。
AI.conclusion: 该任务建立了生成式抄袭检测的基准数据集与评估框架，表明现有方法可在该设定下有效检索原始来源，并为后续研究提供可比较的实验平台。

title: Lived Experiences of Power and Agency: Achieving Voice Sovereignty in Assistive Speech Technology for Nonbinary Users
summary: Speech-generating devices (SGDs) are essential tools for many speech-disabled individuals, yet current systems often reinforce normative assumptions about identity and communication. Prior research on gender expansive SGD users has largely focused on gendered voice options, with less attention to broader identity alignment and the technological conditions that shape users' agency. This study examines how gender expansive SGD users experience power over their voices using thematic analysis of qualitative survey data. Three themes emerged: (1) integration of SGDs into daily life, (2) identity expression, and (3) power and agency. Participants expressed the need for more responsive and reliable technology, inclusive and customizable voices, and greater autonomy in defining how their voices sound and are perceived. Ultimately, their perspectives call for a reimagining of SGD systems as tools for reclaiming the power of one's voice and the ability to define and enact one's will through it.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过定性调查的主题分析，考察性别 expansive 的语音生成设备（SGD）用户如何体验对其"声音"的掌控权，提炼出三个主题并呼吁重新构想SGD系统，使其成为用户夺回声音权力与意志表达能力的工具。
AI.motivation: 现有SGD系统常强化关于身份与沟通的规范性假设；既往针对性别多元SGD用户的研究多局限于性别化语音选项，对更广泛的身份契合度及塑造用户能动性的技术条件关注不足。
AI.method: 对性别 expansive 的SGD用户进行定性问卷调查，并采用主题分析法（thematic analysis）归纳其使用体验。
AI.result: 提炼出三个主题：(1) SGD融入日常生活；(2) 身份表达；(3) 权力与能动性。参与者提出对更具响应性、更可靠技术的需求，对包容且可定制语音的需求，以及在定义声音样貌与感知方式上更大自主权的需求。
AI.conclusion: 参与者的视角要求重新构想SGD系统，将其定位为帮助用户夺回声音权力、并通过声音定义与践行自身意志的工具。

title: RSIMed: Scaling Medical Foundation Models beyond Limited Clinical Data via Retrieval-Grounded Self-Evolution
summary: Rare diseases are hard to diagnose, and the labeled clinical records needed to train models for them are few, private, and slow to extend, since a specialist must read every case. A model that writes its own training tasks could learn beyond these records, but no program can check a model-written diagnosis, and a wrong answer key corrupts training. To tackle this dilemma between data scarcity and difficulty of data annotations, we introduce RSIMed, Recursive Self-Improvement in Medicine, one of the first self-evolving pipelines in which a task proposer co-evolves in context with a diagnostic solver on real clinical records. Seeded by training admissions, a frozen copy of the solver writes each clinical question from retrieved medical evidence, so its answer rests on a source, and steers topics and difficulty toward what the solver still gets wrong. On rare-disease diagnosis from MIMIC-IV admissions, the accuracy of RSIMed-27B grows linearly with training compute, while a static pool of generated tasks collapses. Without any external model, RSIMed-27B and RSIMed-9B reach 0.516 and 0.488 diagnostic accuracy, above every off-the-shelf GPT-5.6 setting, whose best reaches 0.399 at 38 times the inference cost of RSIMed-27B. Tasks written by four external teachers, including GPT-5.5, train a less accurate diagnostician than the solver's own. Trained only on diagnosis, RSIMed-RL-27B also improves on the physician-written tasks of HealthBench Professional, from 0.291 to 0.303 in adjusted score.

AI.tldr: 提出 RSIMed：让任务提议者与诊断求解器在真实病历上上下文协同自进化，以自生成、有证据溯源的任务缓解稀有疾病数据稀缺与标注困难；27B/9B 达 0.516/0.488 准确率，超越 GPT-5.6 最佳 0.399（后者推理成本高 38 倍）。
AI.motivation: 稀有疾病诊断困难，可用的标注临床记录稀少、私有且扩展缓慢（每例需专家阅读）。让模型自写训练任务可突破数据边界，但模型自写的诊断答案缺乏可验证性，错误答案键会污染训练——由此形成"数据稀缺 vs 标注困难"的两难。
AI.method: RSIMed（Recursive Self-Improvement in Medicine）自进化流水线：以训练入院记录为种子，冻结的求解器副本基于检索到的医学证据生成临床问题，使答案有文献出处；并按求解器当前失败点定向调节主题与难度；任务提议者与诊断求解器在上下文中共同进化，辅以 RL 训练（RSIMed-RL-27B）。
AI.result: 在 MIMIC-IV 入院记录的稀有疾病诊断上，RSIMed-27B 准确率随训练算力线性增长，而静态任务池训练会崩溃；无外部模型时 RSIMed-27B/9B 分别达 0.516/0.488，高于所有 GPT-5.6 设置最佳 0.399（其推理成本为 RSIMed-27B 的 38 倍）；四个外部教师（含 GPT-5.5）生成任务训练出的诊断器不如求解器自生成任务；仅用诊断训练，HealthBench Professional 医师撰写任务调整分从 0.291 提升至 0.303。
AI.conclusion: 自生成、证据锚定的任务可替代外部教师与昂贵专有模型，形成可随算力持续扩展的医学诊断自进化训练路径，并具备向通用医学基准的迁移能力。

title: CONTEXT-PCa: Evaluating the role of clinical context in MRI-based AI for detecting clinically significant prostate cancer (study protocol)
summary: The objective of this study is to investigate the role of clinical variables - their breadth, source, and quality - in the development, utility, and generalisability of an AI system for bi-parametric MRI (bpMRI)-based diagnosis of clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa). Clinical context is added to the published PI-CAI-2B image-only model, whose weights are fixed. The study cohort comprises 6,022 biparametric MRI cases from 4,540 patients at University College London Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust (2019-2024), of which 4,834 cases (3,632 patients) are held out for internal testing. Forty-three clinical variables are drawn from structured health records, clinical letters, MRI reports, and automated image measurements. The primary endpoint is the difference in the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) between the image-context and image-only models on the internal test set. Secondary analyses compare combining strategies, the contribution of individual variables, and performance across subgroups. All models are further tested on five external cohorts from primary diagnosis and population-based screening.

AI.tldr: 研究评估临床变量（广度、来源、质量）对基于bpMRI的前列腺癌AI系统开发、效用与泛化性的作用，在固定权重的PI-CAI-2B纯图像模型上加入临床上下文，使用UCLH 6,022例数据（43个临床变量）以AUROC差异为主要终点，并在五个外部队列中验证。
AI.motivation: 探究临床变量在AI系统开发、临床应用价值与泛化能力中扮演的角色，弥补纯图像模型缺乏临床上下文的不足。
AI.method: 在已发表且权重固定的PI-CAI-2B图像-only模型基础上加入临床上下文；队列为UCLH 2019–2024年4,540名患者的6,022例bpMRI（4,834例/3,632名患者作内部测试）；从结构化健康记录、临床信件、MRI报告及自动化图像测量中提取43个临床变量；主要终点为内部测试集上图像+上下文模型与纯图像模型的AUROC差异；次要分析比较融合策略、单变量贡献及亚组表现；并在五个外部队列（初诊与人群筛查）上进一步测试。
AI.result: 摘要仅描述研究设计与分析计划，未报告具体AUROC数值或统计结果。
AI.conclusion: 该研究将通过内部测试与五个外部队列，系统评估临床变量对bpMRI前列腺癌AI诊断性能及泛化性的增益。

title: IntentFlow: An Intent-Driven Real-Time Multimodal Search System with Image-Text Queries at Xiaohongshu
summary: Multimodal search with image-text queries helps users find notes in user-generated content (UGC) communities and serves as a key search tool for multimodal search agents. For such queries, query-note relevance depends on the user's retrieval intent and cannot be determined by visual or topical similarity alone. Simply reranking visual search results cannot fully address this challenge, as notes relevant to the user's intent may be missing from the initial candidate set. This motivates explicit intent modeling to align candidate retrieval and reranking under consistent relevance criteria. We present IntentFlow, an intent-driven real-time multimodal search system deployed at Xiaohongshu over an index on the order of ten billion entries. IntentFlow represents retrieval objectives with a hierarchical intent taxonomy and uses intent-specific relevance criteria to guide data construction, representation learning, and reranking. An offline agentic data workflow acquires candidates and verifies their relevance under these criteria to produce training supervision. The embedding model combines intent-aware contrastive learning, graded ranking, and distribution distillation, while a compact reranker assesses query-candidate evidence conditioned on predicted hierarchical intents. Evaluations demonstrate that IntentFlow delivers substantial gains in search engagement while supporting real-time search at industrial scale. In a user-level A/B test on the Xiaohongshu platform, IntentFlow outperforms the existing production system based on visual search followed by reranking, achieving relative gains of 28.17% in Top-4 query click-through rate, 18.96% in query click-through rate, and 12.56% in average time spent on search results pages per user. Production monitoring records an end-to-end P50 latency of 1.07 s.

AI.tldr: 提出意图驱动的实时多模态搜索系统 IntentFlow，在小红书百亿级索引上部署，通过层级意图分类体系统一指导数据构建、表征学习与重排序；A/B 测试中 Top-4 查询点击率相对提升 28.17%，端到端 P50 时延 1.07 s。
AI.motivation: 图-文查询的相关性取决于用户检索意图，无法仅由视觉或主题相似度判定；单纯对视觉搜索结果重排序不足以解决问题，因为符合意图的笔记可能根本不在初始候选集中，因此需要显式意图建模，使候选召回与重排序在一致的相关性准则下对齐。
AI.method: 采用层级意图分类体系表征检索目标，并以意图特定的相关性准则指导数据构建、表征学习与重排序；离线 agentic 数据工作流负责获取候选并按准则验证相关性以生成训练监督；嵌入模型融合意图感知对比学习、分级排序（graded ranking）与分布蒸馏；紧凑型重排序器以预测的层级意图为条件评估查询-候选证据。
AI.result: 在小红书用户级 A/B 测试中优于现有"视觉搜索+重排序"生产系统：Top-4 查询点击率相对提升 28.17%，查询点击率提升 18.96%，人均搜索结果页停留时长提升 12.56%；生产监控端到端 P50 时延为 1.07 s，满足工业级实时搜索需求。
AI.conclusion: 意图驱动的一致相关性建模可显著提升大规模 UGC 多模态搜索的检索效果与用户参与度，并已在百亿级索引的工业系统中验证其可行性与实时性。

title: Auditing a Moving Target: Evidence Anchoring and the Expiry of Fairness Audits of Provider-Served Language Models
summary: Organizations increasingly use large language models (LLMs) for decisions about people, such as hiring, investment and employee evaluation, and rely on them over long periods of time. Fairness audits of such systems, however, are conducted only once. We examine how the biases of LLMs change over time. In a venture screening setting, models from five providers decided whether and how much to invest in startups whose founders differed only in gender, origin and university. We repeated this audit three times over 13 months (248,400 API calls). Study 1 shows that the same model, called under the same identifier one year later, displayed a significantly different bias pattern. Study 2 shows that the successors of retired models carried the same bias as their predecessors, but in a significantly different size and form. Study 3 shows that the bias does not depend on the industry of the startup. A document analysis further shows that providers change and retire models at their discretion, with notice periods of zero to six months. Drawing on these findings, we develop a theory of evidence anchoring. We theorize that bias resides in the model class and persists, whereas audit evidence is anchored to a single model and expires when the provider decides. We derive policy advice for organizations and regulators, namely audits of model classes instead of single models, a version record for every model response, and re-audits triggered by model changes.

AI.tldr: 通过对LLM进行跨13个月、248,400次API调用的重复公平性审计，发现同一模型的偏见模式随时间显著变化，继任模型继承前代偏见但幅度与形式不同，且偏见与行业无关；据此提出"证据锚定"理论，主张审计对象应为模型类而非单一模型，并建议版本记录与变更触发再审计。
AI.motivation: 组织长期依赖LLM做出招聘、投资、员工评估等涉及人的决策，但公平性审计通常只做一次。论文旨在检验LLM偏见是否随时间稳定，从而质疑"一次性审计"的有效性前提。
AI.method: 采用风险筛选（venture screening）场景的审计实验：五家供应商的模型决定是否及向"仅创始人在性别、出身、大学上不同"的初创企业投资多少；在13个月内重复审计三次，共248,400次API调用。研究1比较同一标识符下同一模型一年后的偏见模式；研究2比较退役模型与其继任模型的偏见传承；研究3检验偏见是否依赖企业所属行业；另辅以文档分析考察供应商的模型变更与退役策略及通知期。
AI.result: 研究1：同一模型在相同标识符下调用，一年后呈现显著不同的偏见模式。研究2：退役模型的继任者继承了前代的偏见，但幅度与形式显著不同。研究3：偏见不依赖初创企业所属行业。文档分析：供应商自行决定模型变更与退役，通知期从0到6个月不等。
AI.conclusion: 提出"证据锚定"理论：偏见存在于模型类（model class）中并持续存在，而审计证据锚定于单一模型，并随供应商决定的模型退役而失效。据此向组织与监管者提出政策建议：审计模型类而非单一模型、为每条模型响应建立版本记录、以及由模型变更触发再审计。

title: Screen Before You Add: Reducing Candidate Inference in Model Ensembles
summary: As new models become available, existing ensembles must be updated to be competitive, making them intrinsically dynamic. Deciding whether to add a candidate model can require inference on an entire annotated dataset. Such a screening becomes prohibitive for models with costly inference especially when they ultimately add no value. Even under simple convex aggregation, relying on benchmark scores can be misleading as strong standalone performance does not guarantee ensemble improvement, and fitted ensemble weights can hurt test performance. In this work, we study candidate screening and show how early rejection can be achieved safely, exploiting residual geometry for stratification and rejecting the candidate when the best possible remaining predictions cannot achieve the necessary improvement. The key result that justifies this approach is that, under convex aggregation and squared or Brier loss, the population optimum improves if and only if a candidate induces a prediction change positively aligned with the residuals of the population-optimal existing ensemble. An optimistic quadratic program (QP) provides certified early rejection, while posterior-scenario sampling offers an alternative heuristic. We evaluate the approach by showing the tradeoff between saved calls and screening accuracy, which refers to recovering the same accept/reject result as for the entire annotated dataset. We assess empirically whether full-dataset decisions predict candidate usefulness on a held-out test set. On two LLM panels, stratified screening with certified QP rejection saves 21-23% of candidate calls while keeping 100% screening accuracy. In our experiments, sampling posterior scenarios further increases call savings to approximately 37%, with a loss of less than one percentage point in screening accuracy.

AI.tldr: 针对动态集成中候选模型筛选成本过高的问题，提出基于残差几何的乐观二次规划（QP）早期拒绝方法，在凸聚合与平方/Brier损失下可认证地跳过大部分候选推理，实现21–37%的调用节省且几乎不损失筛选准确率。
AI.motivation: 模型迭代导致集成需不断更新，候选模型是否应加入需在整个标注数据集上推理才能判定；对高推理成本模型代价高昂，且强单模型benchmark分数并不能保证集成提升，拟合权重甚至可能损害测试性能。
AI.method: 理论证明：在凸聚合与平方/Brier损失下，总体最优集成得到改善当且仅当候选引起的预测变化与现有最优集成残差正相关。据此用残差几何做分层，以乐观二次规划给出认证式早期拒绝（当剩余最优可能预测仍无法达到所需改进时拒绝），并提出后验情景采样作为启发式替代。
AI.result: 在两个LLM面板上，认证QP分层筛选节省21–23%候选调用且筛选准确率100%；后验情景采样将节省提升至约37%，准确率损失不足1个百分点；并检验了全数据集决策对留出测试集上候选有用性的预测能力。
AI.conclusion: 候选筛选可安全地提前拒绝，残差对齐条件为凸聚合下的充分必要条件；认证QP提供可靠保证，情景采样在可接受精度损失下换取更高效率。

title: Instructor-designed AI improves learning in a randomized trial across 19 universities
summary: Universities are alarmed by recent evidence that artificial intelligence (AI) can undermine learning, with students prescribed generic chatbots or centrally designed AI tools performing worse. In a pre-registered randomized controlled trial across 7,200 students at 19 universities over three semesters, we tested whether AI designed by frontline instructors can improve learning. We encouraged instructors to design AI solutions they believed would best help their students. Drawing on their unique knowledge of their classes and students, the instructors created a wide array of innovations. We show that these instructor-designed AI innovations improved student learning, measured by AI-proof assessments (proctored, in-person examinations). We found no change in student engagement, measured by course activity records, or satisfaction, measured by course evaluations. Our findings demonstrate that AI can improve student learning when its adoption is frontline-driven, with instructors empowered to design and refine AI solutions for their own classrooms.

AI.tldr: 在一项覆盖19所大学7200名学生、历时三学期的预注册随机对照试验中，由一线教师自主设计的AI工具显著提升了学生在防AI作弊的线下监考考试中的学习成绩，但对学生参与度和满意度无影响。
AI.motivation: 近期证据显示，通用聊天机器人或集中设计的AI工具反而损害学生学习，引发高校担忧。作者由此提出：若AI由了解课堂与学生的一线教师设计，是否能改善学习效果。
AI.method: 预注册随机对照试验（RCT），覆盖19所大学、7200名学生、三个学期；鼓励教师基于其课堂与学生知识自行设计AI解决方案，形成多样化创新；学习效果以防AI作弊的线下监考考试（proctored in-person exams）测量，学生参与度以课程活动记录测量，满意度以课程评价测量。
AI.result: 教师自主设计的AI创新提升了学生学习成绩；学生参与度（课程活动记录）和满意度（课程评价）均无显著变化。
AI.conclusion: 当AI的采用由一线驱动、并赋予教师为其课堂设计和迭代AI方案的能力时，AI能够提升学生学习。这为高校AI部署策略提供了"教师赋权"路径的证据。

title: MAGE: Meta-path Adaptive Graph Evidence for Transferable Multimodal Graph Learning
summary: Multimodal graphs integrate textual and visual attributes with relational structures, providing a rich representation of complex real-world data. To enable the broad applicability and reuse of graph models, it is crucial for models trained on source graphs to generalize to unseen graph domains. However, this is challenging because cross-modal interactions among neighbors and the neighboring information needed for prediction can vary across target nodes and graph domains. This gives rise to two key challenges: adaptive cross-modal neighborhood fusion, which captures and integrates cross-modal interactions among neighbors to accommodate variations across nodes and domains; and target-specific evidence selection, which identifies the neighboring textual and visual information needed for each target node to support LLM-based prediction. In light of these challenges, we propose MAGE (Meta-path Adaptive Graph Evidence Prompting), a framework for transferable multimodal graph learning. MAGE represents textual and visual node views separately in a heterogeneous graph and introduces two complementary components. Meta-path Adaptive Multimodal Propagation (MAMP) adaptively aggregates neighborhood information along heterogeneous meta-paths and compresses it into graph-aware soft tokens. Evidence-Guided Instruction Tuning (EGIT) selects relevant neighboring evidence for each query and incorporates its graph-aware representations into instructions for a frozen multimodal LLM. Together, these components support transfer from multiple source graphs to unseen target graphs without target-domain parameter updates. Experiments with three source graphs and four unseen target graphs demonstrate strong cross-domain transfer performance on node classification and link prediction, without requiring parameter updates on the target domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MAGE 框架，将文本与视觉视图分置于异质图中，通过元路径自适应传播与证据引导指令微调，实现向未见目标图的可迁移多模态图学习，无需目标域参数更新。
AI.motivation: 多模态图模型要在新图上复用，需具备跨域泛化能力；但邻居间的跨模态交互以及预测所需邻域信息随节点和图域变化，由此带来自适应跨模态邻域融合与目标特定证据选择两大挑战。
AI.method: MAGE 将文本与视觉节点视图分别在异质图中表示，并引入两个互补组件：元路径自适应多模态传播（MAMP）沿异质元路径自适应聚合邻域信息并压缩为图感知软 token；证据引导指令微调（EGIT）为每个查询选择相关邻居证据，并将其图感知表示注入冻结多模态 LLM 的指令中。
AI.result: 在三个源图和四个未见目标图上，节点分类与链接预测均表现出强跨域迁移性能，且目标域无需参数更新。
AI.conclusion: MAGE 通过元路径自适应传播与证据引导指令微调，实现了多源图到未见目标图的无参数更新迁移，验证了多模态图模型跨域泛化的可行性。

title: A Crowd-Audited Atlas of Implicit Bias in LLM-Powered Agents
summary: Prior work has shown that large language models (LLMs) express implicit biases in high-publicity, one-off decision scenarios such as hiring and intelligence assessment. However, as people increasingly employ autonomous, LLM-powered AI agents that make decisions on their behalf in doing day-to-day tasks, it is of critical importance that we understand how implicit biases, based on sociodemographic assumptions, emerge across a broad milieu of workaday decision scenarios. We used the 17 domains of daily activity in the American Time Use Survey (ATUS) to generate an atlas of 506 decision scenarios in which LLMs --- endowed with personas representing different races, gender identities, and political ideologies --- expressed significant implicit bias. Next, in a crowdsourced audit, 500 participants made 8,010 binary choices about which implicitly biased decision scenarios most deserved further review. We found that participants prioritized decision scenarios that had broad relevance (e.g., about food choices), were high stakes (e.g., about health), and where all members of a simulated sociodemographic group made unanimous decisions (because it was a clear indication of stereotyping). They were less swayed by the magnitude of an observed disparity or the specific ATUS domain the decision scenario represented. When examining the rationale behind their prioritization choices, we found that participants often interpreted disparities as traits of demographic groups and judged whether those traits seemed plausible, often based on their own internalized stereotypes. We discuss implications for building personalized AI agents, digital twins, social simulations, and for using crowdsourced bias audits.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了涵盖美国时间使用调查（ATUS）17个日常活动领域的506个决策场景图谱，揭示LLM在代入不同种族、性别认同与政治意识形态人格时表现出显著隐性偏见，并通过500名参与者的众包审计（8,010次二选一）发现，人们倾向于优先审查涉及面广、高风险、且某社会人口群体成员决策高度一致的场景，而较少受差异幅度或具体领域影响。
AI.motivation: 既有研究多聚焦招聘、智力评估等高曝光的一次性决策场景中的LLM隐性偏见，但随着LLM驱动的自主智能体被广泛用于代理日常任务，亟需理解基于社会人口假设的隐性偏见在大量日常决策场景中如何涌现，以及人们会如何优先关注这些偏见。
AI.method: 基于ATUS的17个日常活动领域生成506个决策场景；为LLM赋予代表不同种族、性别认同和政治意识形态的persona，测量其隐性偏见；随后开展众包审计，让500名参与者完成8,010次二选一，判断哪些偏见场景最值得进一步审查，并分析其优先级判断的理由。
AI.result: 参与者优先关注具有广泛相关性（如食物选择）、高风险（如健康）以及某模拟社会人口群体成员决策完全一致的场景（一致性被视为刻板印象的明确信号）；差异幅度大小和具体ATUS领域对优先级判断影响较小。理由分析显示，参与者常将差异解读为人口群体的特质，并依据自身内化刻板印象判断其是否可信。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示LLM偏见在日常生活决策中的普遍性与人群审查偏好的形成机制，对构建个性化AI智能体、数字孪生、社会模拟以及使用众包偏见审计具有启示意义。

title: Rethinking Offline On-Policy Distillation: From Scalar Advantages to Distributional Supervision
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers teacher capabilities through token-level feedback on student-generated trajectories, but repeatedly evaluating fresh rollouts with the teacher is computationally expensive. Offline methods such as Lightning OPD reduce this cost by caching recorded tokens' teacher log-probabilities on fixed reference rollouts. By extending the idea to a multi-turn agentic search setup, we find that it consistently underperforms the SFT starting point trained by the same teacher. We empirically observe greater teacher--reference mismatch than in mathematical reasoning and post-training distributional flattening, and theoretically show that scalar advantage supervision on fixed rollouts admits solutions with flattened output distributions under suitable conditions. Motivated by these findings, we propose Distributional On-Policy Distillation (DistOPD), a simple yet effective offline OPD method that retains candidate-token probabilities from both reference and teacher at selected positions and aggregates the remaining parts into a residual token. On agentic search, DistOPD achieves performance comparable to online OPD while improving student--teacher alignment and using training GPU-hours comparable to Lightning OPD.

AI.tldr: 离线OPD（如Lightning OPD）在多轮智能体搜索中劣于同教师SFT起点；作者归因于教师-参考分布错配与后训练分布扁平化，并从理论上证明固定轨迹上的标量优势监督会退化为分布扁平解。提出DistOPD：在选定位置保留参考与教师的候选token概率并将剩余部分聚合为残差token，实现分布级蒸馏。在agentic search上达到与在线OPD相当的性能，同时改善学生-教师对齐，训练GPU时数与Lightning OPD相当。
AI.motivation: 在线同策略蒸馏（OPD）需教师反复评估新采样轨迹，计算昂贵；离线缓存式OPD（Lightning OPD）虽省算力，但扩展到多轮智能体搜索场景时持续劣于同教师训练的SFT起点。作者发现该场景下教师-参考错配更严重、后训练分布出现扁平化，并指出标量优势监督在固定轨迹上存在分布扁平的退化解，因此需要保留完整分布信息的离线OPD方法。
AI.method: 理论上分析固定轨迹上标量优势监督的解空间，证明在适当条件下存在输出分布扁平的可行解；据此提出DistOPD：在选定位置同时保留参考模型与教师的候选token概率，将剩余词表部分聚合为单个残差token，从而以分布级（而非标量优势）形式进行离线同策略蒸馏。
AI.result: 在agentic search任务上，DistOPD性能与在线OPD相当，优于Lightning OPD等离线基线及SFT起点；学生-教师对齐程度提升，训练GPU时数与Lightning OPD处于同一量级。
AI.conclusion: 标量优势监督的信息瓶颈是离线OPD在智能体搜索中失效的关键原因；改为保留候选token分布并配合残差token聚合，可在保持离线低成本的同时逼近在线OPD效果，为多轮智能体场景下的高效蒸馏提供可行方案。

title: Guiding AI Agents to Generate Conjectures by Encoding How Theorems Build on One Another
summary: Recently, LLMs have been making headlines, and headway, in mathematical research. Much of this work focuses on proving existing open conjectures. Deciding what to prove is harder and less studied, because of the lack of a clear criterion for what makes a conjecture worth pursuing. We present a method for conjecture generation that builds on the observation that mathematical theorems build on one another: new theorems can modify the setting or hypotheses of earlier theorems, strengthen their conclusions, or extend their scope. We encode these relationships in a new kind of graph, the Theorem Evolution Graph (TEG), which we instantiate as an online search method for LLM agents. An agent builds a TEG in two steps: (1) identifying relevant theorems from papers found by following citations backward and forward from a seed paper; and (2) comparing those theorems to record how one builds on another.
