LLM judges and an expert mathematician preferred TEG-generated conjectures over those from an unconstrained baseline. LLM judges favored TEG conjectures for significance, ambition, and insight, and favored baseline conjectures for plausibility. Ablations suggest a benefit from constructing and using a TEG even when the available papers are fixed.

AI.tldr: 论文提出定理演化图（TEG），将定理间"继承—强化—拓展"关系编码为图结构，并实例化为LLM智能体的在线搜索方法用于猜想生成，经LLM评审与专家数学家评估显示其生成猜想在重要性、抱负和洞见上优于无约束基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM数学研究多聚焦于证明已有公开猜想，而"该证明什么"（即猜想的选择与生成）研究较少，主因是缺乏判断猜想价值的标准。作者观察到数学定理彼此建立在对方之上，借此为猜想生成提供可操作的结构化准则。
AI.method: 构建定理演化图（TEG）：节点为定理，边记录定理间的演化关系（修改设定或假设、强化结论、扩展适用范围）。将其实例化为LLM智能体的在线搜索流程，分两步：(1) 从种子论文出发沿引用前向与后向追踪，识别相关定理；(2) 比较定理对并记录其演化关系以构图。
AI.result: LLM评审与专家数学家均更偏好TEG生成的猜想而非无约束基线；LLM评审认为TEG猜想在重要性、抱负与洞见维度更优，而基线猜想在合理性（plausibility）上更强。消融实验表明，即使固定可用论文集合，构建并使用TEG仍带来收益。
AI.conclusion: 以定理演化关系为归纳偏置可有效引导LLM生成更有价值的数学猜想，TEG既是结构化知识表示也是可执行的搜索机制；代价是生成猜想的合理性有所下降，提示重要性与可信度之间存在权衡。

title: When the Bill Falls: Reusing the Old Index Defers,Never Avoids, Re-encoding in Complete Embedding-Model Migration
summary: Upgrading the embedding model behind a vector index requires re-encoding the corpus. Recent work reuses the old index through adapters or window re-ranking. Across sixteen model pairs on passage and code corpora, plus eleven on Natural Questions (NQ), we find three results. First, reuse never avoids re-encoding: if migration must complete, every strategy eventually encodes every document; reuse only changes when that work is paid and the quality served meanwhile. Second, adapters should be compared with the old model, not only the new one. Of five adapter variants, only same-family LLM bridges beat the old model, and only by a negligible margin. Third, window re-ranking cost can be priced from the old index alone; pre-registered replays on all 8,841,823 passages confirmed the prediction on all three tested pairs. Workload skew also matters: across 36 further pre-registered Zipf replays, the planned family matched on 32. These findings yield three pre-migration rules: whether reuse is worthwhile, which strategy to use, and how deep a window to take. The depth rule priced every window that reached target quality to within 4 parts in 10^5 of the corpus. On NQ, a pre-committed plan selected the family on 10 of 11 pairs and priced every window exactly. Quality inputs transferred less reliably across corpus scale, so the model gap and window quality loss must be measured on the serving index.

AI.tldr: 升级向量索引背后的嵌入模型必须重编码语料；本文通过16组模型对（另有NQ上11组）证明"复用"只是推迟而非消除重编码，并给出三条迁移前决策规则。
AI.motivation: 替换嵌入模型需对整个语料重新编码，成本高昂，近期工作提出用适配器或窗口重排序来复用旧索引。但缺乏对"复用是否值得、该选哪种策略、窗口取多深"的系统性量化分析，本文旨在为迁移前的策略选择提供可预注册、可精确预测的判据。
AI.method: 在passage与代码语料上考察16组模型对，NQ上考察11组；比较5种适配器变体；提出仅依赖旧索引即可对窗口重排序成本定价的方法，并在全部8,841,823个passage上做预注册回放；进一步做36次预注册Zipf工作负载偏斜回放，检验策略族匹配。
AI.result: （1）复用从不真正避免编码：迁移完成后每个文档终将被编码，复用只改变付费时点与过渡期质量。（2）5种适配器中仅同族LLM桥接优于旧模型，且优势可忽略——适配器应与旧模型而非仅与新模型比较。（3）窗口重排序成本可由旧索引单独预测，三组测试模型对的预测全部被回放证实；Zipf回放中36次有32次策略族匹配；深度规则对达到目标质量的每个窗口定价误差在语料的4×10⁻⁵以内；NQ上预承诺方案在11对中10对选对策略族且窗口定价完全精确。
AI.conclusion: 得到三条迁移前规则：复用是否值得、采用何种策略、窗口取多深。质量相关输入跨语料规模的迁移性较差，模型间差距与窗口质量损失必须在实际服务索引上测量。

title: Synthetic Doubt and the Integrity of Digital Proof before the International Criminal Court
summary: Generative artificial intelligence complicates evidentiary assessment at the International Criminal Court by enabling fabricated audiovisual material and making authentic digital evidence easier to dismiss as fake. This article calls the latter problem synthetic doubt: an objection alleging that a digital item may be AI-generated or AI-manipulated. Existing scholarship addresses digital evidence, open-source investigations and deepfakes in the ICC context. Yet the question of when synthetic doubt should trigger enhanced reliability review under the Rome Statute, without displacing the prosecution's burden under article 66 or compromising article 67 fair-trial rights, remains underdeveloped. The article proposes a three-stage framework: a baseline authenticity and provenance showing by the proponent; a case-specific articulation threshold for the objector; and proportionate reliability review by the Chamber under articles 64 and 69(4). The framework treats AI-related provenance information and synthetic-media detector outputs as contextual rather than dispositive.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"合成怀疑"概念，即质疑数字证据可能由生成式AI合成或篡改，并构建三阶段框架以规范国际刑事法院对这类异议的可靠性审查。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI既能制造伪造视听材料，也使真实数字证据更易被指为"假的"，这种"合成怀疑"给国际刑事法院的证据评估带来双重困境。现有研究虽涉及数字证据、开源调查与深度伪造，但未解决核心问题：在《罗马规约》下，合成怀疑何时应触发强化可靠性审查，同时不转移第66条的检方举证责任、不损害第67条的公正审判权。
AI.method: 提出三阶段框架：第一阶段由证据提出方进行基础性的真实性与来源证明；第二阶段为异议方设定针对个案的具体化阐述门槛；第三阶段由分庭依据第64条与第69条第4款进行相称的可靠性审查。框架将AI相关来源信息与合成媒体检测器输出定位为情境性而非决定性证据。
AI.result: 该框架为分庭提供了结构化的裁量路径：异议方须先具体化其合成怀疑理由，避免空泛质疑；审查强度与异议的具体程度相称，从而在保障证据可靠性的同时维持举证责任分配与公正审判权。
AI.conclusion: 合成怀疑不应自动引发强化审查，而应经由"基础证明—具体化门槛—相称审查"的三阶段机制加以过滤；AI来源信息与检测工具结论仅具情境价值，不能单独决定证据真伪。

title: Algebraic Interaction: A Recipe for Neural Architecture Generation
summary: We introduce an algebraic foundation for neural architecture design in which convolution, attention, state-space models, and equivariant layers are expressed through compositions of bilinear product operators over two structures: a position algebra governing positional routing and a feature algebra governing feature interactions. This decomposition makes routing, feature algebra, and operator composition explicit design variables.We focus on the feature-algebra axis through an Algebraic Recipe: fix the routing and operator composition of an existing architecture while replacing its feature algebra. This preserves the information-flow structure while allowing computational and symmetry properties to be modified through algebraic specification.We instantiate the recipe in linear attention, Mamba, and equivariant networks. Structure-constant and Clifford algebras improve accuracy at comparable parameter count in linear attention; structure-constant algebras yield up to $3\times$ faster training and inference in Vision Mamba at competitive accuracy; and an $\mathrm{SO}(3)$-representation algebra provides rotational equivariance by construction. These results demonstrate that feature algebra alone can control accuracy, efficiency, and symmetry without redesigning positional routing.This turns algebraic structure into an explicit design variable and reduces architecture design, within our framework, to algebraic specification.

AI.tldr: 提出一种用双线性乘积算子组合刻画神经架构的代数框架，将架构设计分解为位置代数与特征代数，并验证仅替换特征代数即可调控精度、效率与对称性。
AI.motivation: 卷积、注意力、状态空间模型与等变层缺乏统一的设计语言，各组件相互耦合，难以将路由（信息流）与特征交互分离为独立可控的设计变量。
AI.method: 将算子表达为两个结构上的双线性乘积算子组合：位置代数（控制位置路由）与特征代数（控制特征交互）。据此提出"代数配方"：固定既有架构的路由与算子组合方式，仅替换其特征代数，从而在保持信息流结构的前提下通过代数规格改变计算与对称性质。在线性注意力、Mamba 与等变网络中实例化该配方。
AI.result: 线性注意力中，结构常数代数与 Clifford 代数在参数可比条件下提升精度；Vision Mamba 中结构常数代数在竞争性精度下带来最高 3 倍训练与推理加速；SO(3) 表示代数以构造方式实现旋转等变性。
AI.conclusion: 仅改变特征代数即可控制精度、效率与对称性，无需重新设计位置路由；代数结构成为显式设计变量，框架内架构设计可简化为代数规格说明。

title: CLEAR: Legible and Steerable Recommendation via Grounded Natural-Language Interests
summary: Modern recommenders keep learned preferences in representations people cannot inspect or change. We present CLEAR (Controllable and Legible End-to-end Architecture for Recommendation), an end-to-end system deployed at Meta and built around an editable natural-language interest layer. CLEAR makes a ranked subset of inferred interests readable and stores accepted additions and suppressions as authoritative preference state. Behavioral grounding maps each inferred interest back to supporting events in the user's own history. The resulting interest object is also a serving address: its label and profile-conditioned rewrites drive lexical retrieval, its supporting events seed behavioral retrieval, its projection queries an embedding index, and its stable identity supports ranking, attribution, and exposure control. A fresh user declaration may precede behavioral support, so it enters through the same serving identity and initially draws candidates from topical retrieval. Ranking makes those candidates competitive, while a delivery controller observes attributable exposure and replenishes underexposed interests. Direct user review found that users rated about 88.5% of displayed interests accurate. In an offline benchmark using a shared evaluation protocol, the Specialized 3B generator reached 0.3967 mean-user F1@10, compared with 0.3633 for Gemini 2.5 Pro and 0.1911 for the prior generator. For a newly declared interest, a user-randomized cumulative ablation measured same-day delivery losses of 8.7 percentage points for added-interest ranking terms, 11.1 for reserved top-slot insertion, and 13.7 for interest-conditioned candidate sourcing, conditional on the tested removal sequence. CLEAR components have operated in production for over one year; the system spans four surfaces on Instagram and Facebook, with an interest layer people can inspect, correct, and use to direct recommendations.

AI.tldr: CLEAR 是一个部署在 Meta 的端到端推荐系统，以可编辑的自然语言兴趣层为核心，让用户可查看、纠正并用兴趣对象直接驱动检索与排序，用户对约 88.5% 展示兴趣评为准确。
AI.motivation: 现代推荐器将学到的偏好编码在用户无法检查或修改的表示中，缺乏可解释性与可控性。作者希望把推断出的兴趣转化为可读、可编辑的权威偏好状态，并使其同时充当服务寻址入口，从而统一"可解释—可控制—可服务"三者。
AI.method: 系统围绕可编辑的自然语言兴趣层构建：行为归因把每个推断兴趣映射回用户历史中的支撑事件；兴趣对象作为服务地址，其标签与画像条件改写驱动词法检索，支撑事件用于行为检索，投影查询向量索引，稳定身份支持排序、归因与曝光控制。新声明的兴趣可在行为支撑出现前通过同一服务身份进入，初期由主题检索供给候选，排序使其具备竞争力，投放控制器监控可归因曝光并补充曝光不足的兴趣。评估包含直接用户评审、共享协议的离线基准（含专门的 3B 生成器对比 Gemini 2.5 Pro 与旧生成器），以及针对新声明兴趣的用户随机化累积消融实验。
AI.result: 用户评审中约 88.5% 的展示兴趣被评为准确；离线基准中专用 3B 生成器取得 0.3967 mean-user F1@10，优于 Gemini 2.5 Pro 的 0.3633 和旧生成器的 0.1911；针对新声明兴趣的累积消融显示同日投放损失分别为：新增兴趣排序项 8.7 个百分点、预留顶部位置插入 11.1 个百分点、兴趣条件候选供给 13.7 个百分点（以测试的移除顺序为条件）。
AI.conclusion: CLEAR 各组件已上线运行超过一年，覆盖 Instagram 与 Facebook 的四个界面，提供了用户可检查、纠正并用于指导推荐的利益层，验证了可编辑自然语言兴趣层在大规模生产推荐中的可行性与有效性。

title: CARE: Contrastive-Anchored Residual Encoding with Listwise Reconstruction for Retrieval-Oriented Semantic IDs
summary: Generative retrieval replaces nearest-neighbor search with the generation of a document's semantic ID (SID), so the SID tokenizer bounds what the retriever can recall. Common SID constructions (residual k-means, RQ-VAE, finite scalar quantization, capacity balancing) optimize criteria defined on document embeddings alone and do not control whether a query can still find its relevant documents after quantization. We propose two retrieval-oriented SID tokenizers. CARE-SID (Contrastive-Anchored Residual Encoding for Semantic IDs) quantizes in a retrieval-aligned space: a zero-initialized residual alignment network is trained with a query-document contrastive loss before quantization, an anchor loss and a reconstruction target fixed to the original embedding prevent drift and collapse, and reference-vector rating residual quantization assigns the codes. CARE-LR (CARE with Listwise Reconstruction) then distills, for each training query, the similarity distribution that the original embeddings induce over a candidate list into the SID reconstructions, through a function-preserving layer-resolved head. Both keep a document-only encoding interface. We judge SIDs without training a generator, by row-budget recall in a bucketing view (the partition) and a reconstruction view (the SID with its reconstruction). In offline evaluation on industrial video search data, both tokenizers achieve higher reconstruction-view recall than residual k-means, and CARE-LR improves further on CARE-SID, mainly through the listwise distillation. A comparison of two document embeddings shows that contrastive alignment helps most when the embedding has not been trained on search data, and that the embedding affects SID recall far more than the quantizer. CARE-SID is deployed in the generative retrieval stage of an industrial video search system.

AI.tldr: 提出面向检索的SID分词器CARE-SID与CARE-LR：在检索对齐空间中量化，并用列表式重建蒸馏保持查询-文档相似度结构，离线实验在工业视频搜索数据上取得更高重建视图召回，CARE-SID已上线。
AI.motivation: 生成式检索用生成文档语义ID（SID）替代近邻搜索，故SID分词器决定了检索器的召回上限。现有SID构造（残差k-means、RQ-VAE、有限标量量化、容量平衡）仅优化定义在文档嵌入上的目标，未控制量化后查询是否仍能找到其相关文档。
AI.method: 提出两个检索导向的SID分词器。CARE-SID（对比锚定残差编码）：在检索对齐空间中量化——先以查询-文档对比损失训练零初始化的残差对齐网络，锚损失与固定为原始嵌入的重建目标防止漂移与坍缩，再用参考向量评分式残差量化分配码字。CARE-LR在其上加列表式重建：对每个训练查询，把原始嵌入在候选列表上诱导的相似度分布经保函数的逐层解耦头蒸馏到SID重建中。二者均保持仅文档编码的接口。
AI.result: 不训练生成器即可评估SID：在分桶视图（划分）与重建视图（SID及其重建）下衡量行预算召回。工业视频搜索数据离线评测中，两个分词器的重建视图召回均高于残差k-means，CARE-LR在CARE-SID基础上进一步提升，主要来自列表式蒸馏。两种文档嵌入对比显示：对比对齐在嵌入未经搜索数据训练时收益最大，且嵌入对SID召回的影响远大于量化器。
AI.conclusion: 检索导向的SID分词器在保持文档编码接口的同时显著提升SID召回；CARE-SID已部署于工业视频搜索系统的生成式检索阶段，且文档嵌入质量是SID召回的主导因素。

title: Incentive Alignment for Electricity Data Assets in China: A Blockchain-Enabled Contribution-Credit Framework
summary: Modern electricity markets increasingly rely on reported operational contributions to allocate incentives, recognise cooperation, and coordinate activities across multiple organisations. However, supporting evidence for many reported contributions becomes available only after subsequent metering, dispatch, settlement, or auditing processes, making it difficult to reward genuine contributions while discouraging strategic over-reporting. Existing approaches largely address data sharing, performance verification, blockchain record management, or incentive allocation in isolation, providing limited support for integrating delayed evidence into a unified incentive mechanism. This paper proposes a blockchain-enabled contribution-credit framework for truthful reporting under delayed evidence. The framework links authenticated evidence to contribution recognition through dynamic credit updating, escrow, report-linked penalties, and automated incentive execution. Developed using the Chinese electricity market as the primary setting, it is demonstrated through two representative coordination scenarios, with adaptations illustrating its applicability to UK and US electricity-market structures. A controlled heterogeneous-agent simulation evaluates the behavioural effects of the proposed mechanism, while security analysis, public-data workflow analysis, and blockchain implementation experiments assess its practical feasibility. The results show that integrating delayed evidence with dynamic credit, escrow, and report-linked penalties promotes truthful reporting while providing a transparent and auditable process for translating verified operational contributions into incentive allocation. The proposed framework offers a practical mechanism for improving accountability, coordination, and incentive compatibility in collaborative electricity markets.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种区块链赋能的"贡献信用"框架，将延迟到达的验证证据与动态信用、托管、与报告挂钩的惩罚及自动激励执行整合，从而在证据延迟情形下促进电力市场主体如实申报。
AI.motivation: 现代电力市场依据上报的运行贡献分配激励、认可协作，但支撑证据往往在后续计量、调度、结算或审计后才可得，导致"奖励真实贡献"与"抑制策略性虚报"难以兼得；现有研究分别处理数据共享、性能核验、区块链记录管理或激励分配，缺乏将延迟证据统一纳入激励机制的整体方案。
AI.method: 构建区块链赋能的贡献信用框架：通过动态信用更新、托管（escrow）、与报告挂钩的惩罚及自动化激励执行，把经认证的证据与贡献认可相连接；以中国电力市场为主要场景，在两个代表性协作情景中演示，并做适配分析以说明对英国、美国市场结构的适用性；采用受控异构智能体仿真评估行为效应，并结合安全性分析、公共数据流程分析与区块链实现实验评估可行性。
AI.result: 仿真结果显示，将延迟证据与动态信用、托管和报告挂钩惩罚相结合，可促进如实申报，并为"已核验运行贡献→激励分配"提供透明、可审计的转化流程；安全性、流程与实现实验表明方案具有实际可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为协作型电力市场提升问责性、协调性与激励相容性提供了可落地的机制设计路径。

title: MeltKV: Memory-Aligned KV Cache Compression via Variable-Bit Packed Vector Quantization for Long-Context LLMs
comment: 9 pages, 10 figures, 5 tables. To appear in the IEEE/ACM International Conference on Computer-Aided Design (ICCAD 2026)
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on long contexts, making Key-Value (KV) caches dominate memory usage and inference latency. Existing vector quantization (VQ) methods effectively compress KV caches to sub-4-bit levels but often overlook inefficiencies in memory alignment and decoding speed. This work introduces MeltKV, a memory-latency co-optimized KV cache quantization framework for long-context LLM serving. MeltKV employs a memory-aligned variable-bit index packing scheme that adaptively assigns bit-widths to grouped key channels and compactly stores indices within standard data-types, eliminating redundant bits. Additionally, head-wise codebook sharing reduces the total codebook size while maintaining accuracy. Experiments demonstrate that MeltKV effectively compresses KV representations to sub-4-bit levels down to 1 bit and, at comparable perplexity, achieves 48.1% lower memory usage and 52.9% lower latency than state-of-the-art VQ methods.

AI.tldr: MeltKV：面向长上下文 LLM 服务的内存-延迟协同优化 KV cache 量化框架，结合内存对齐变比特索引打包与逐头码本共享，将 KV cache 压至 sub-4-bit（低至 1 bit），在相当困惑度下相较 SOTA 向量量化方法内存降低 48.1%、延迟降低 52.9%。
AI.motivation: 长上下文依赖使 KV cache 主导显存占用与推理延迟；现有向量量化（VQ）方法虽可压至 sub-4-bit，但忽视内存对齐与解码效率的低效问题。
AI.method: 提出 MeltKV：1) 内存对齐的变比特索引打包方案，按分组键通道自适应分配位宽，将索引紧凑存入标准数据类型以消除冗余位；2) 逐头（head-wise）码本共享，在保持精度的同时缩小总码本体积。
AI.result: 可将 KV 表示压缩至 sub-4-bit，最低达 1 bit；在相当困惑度下，内存占用较 SOTA VQ 方法降低 48.1%，延迟降低 52.9%。
AI.conclusion: KV cache 量化需同时关注压缩率与系统级内存对齐/解码效率；MeltKV 通过协同优化在精度与内存、延迟之间取得更优折衷。

title: Conditional Endorsement: Simulating How Adults with Different Skills Evaluate Canada's National AI Strategy
comment: This research was funded by the Future Skills Centre, and an earlier version of this pre-print was submitted as a report to them
summary: Canada's 2026 national AI strategy, AI for All, commits to free AI training for everyone and to expanding business AI adoption, yet it is difficult to anticipate whether these policies will reach adults with uneven skills and circumstances. We ask how adults with diverse skills might rate these policies on support, effectiveness, and personal benefit, how their skills and circumstances shape these evaluations, and what implementation conditions they raise. We built 3,200 generative agents from a weighted sample of the Programme for the International Assessment of Adult Competencies (PIAAC) Cycle 2 respondents, collected their ratings and explanations for 20 policies, and analyzed dialogues between agents with contrasting ratings. The agents supported nearly every policy but were far less confident that they would improve adult AI literacy or benefit them personally. This gap widened as digital technology use declined: agents modeled on adults who had never used a digital device still endorsed the policies but rarely expected to benefit. Agents traced the gap to participation costs, hard-to-exercise rights, and limited community control, and their dialogues specified these conditions rather than resolving disagreement. We describe this pattern as conditional endorsement and argue that AI literacy policy should be designed and evaluated for adults with the fewest digital skills.

AI.tldr: 本文用3,200个基于PIAAC数据的生成式智能体评估加拿大《AI for All》20项政策，发现存在"支持但不确定受益"的"条件性认可"模式，且数字技能越低该落差越大。
AI.motivation: 加拿大2026年国家AI战略承诺为所有人提供免费AI培训并扩大企业AI应用，但难以预判这些政策能否触及技能与处境参差的成年人。作者希望探究不同技能水平的成年人如何评价政策的支持度、有效性与个人受益，以及技能与处境如何塑造这些评价、提出何种实施条件。
AI.method: 基于PIAAC第二轮受访者的加权样本构建3,200个生成式智能体（generative agents），收集其对20项政策的评分与解释，并分析评分对比鲜明的智能体之间的对话。
AI.result: 智能体几乎支持所有政策，但对政策能否提升成人AI素养或使其个人受益信心明显不足；数字技术使用越少，这一落差越大——模拟"从未使用过数字设备"的成年人仍认可政策，却很少预期自身受益。智能体将落差归因于参与成本、权利难以行使、社区控制有限，其对话主要在明确这些条件而非消解分歧。
AI.conclusion: 作者将这一模式概括为"条件性认可"（conditional endorsement），主张AI素养政策应针对数字技能最薄弱的成年人进行设计与评估。

title: UniGraph: A Unified Graph-based Index for Dynamic Hybrid Dense-Sparse Vector Retrieval
summary: Hybrid dense-sparse vector retrieval combines semantic signals from dense representations with lexical signals from sparse representations, typically ranking items by a query-dependent weighted sum of dense and sparse vector distances. Existing systems commonly search separate dense and sparse vector indexes and rerank the union of their candidates, incurring two retrieval passes and potentially discarding items that rank highly only after the semantic and lexical signals are combined. Constructing a graph-based index directly under a hybrid distance can mitigate this premature candidate loss. However, because varying the hybrid weight alters the underlying neighborhood relationships, a single static graph built at a fixed weight cannot accommodate dynamic query-specific weights. Therefore, we propose a Unified Hybrid Graph (UniGraph), which merges neighbor sets computed at multiple hybrid weights into a single bounded-degree graph index, enabling hybrid vector retrieval with different query-specific weights without index reconstruction. We further develop an adaptive weight-guided search framework that chooses between sparse- and dense-guided entry points according to the query weight, together with a dense-first hybrid distance pruning strategy that avoids unnecessary exact sparse distance computations. Extensive experiments show that UniGraph provides a favorable Recall-QPS trade-off across different query weights. In the mixed-weight setting, UniGraph delivers 27.6%~52.3% higher QPS than the fastest baseline on each dataset at Recall@100 greater than or equal to 0.95. UniGraph has been deployed at scale in Ant Group's production environment, where hybrid retrieval with query-dependent weights is in strong demand.

AI.tldr: 提出 UniGraph——将多个混合权重下计算的邻居集合合并为单个有界度图索引，实现无需重建索引即可支持不同查询特定权重的混合稠密-稀疏向量检索，并配套自适应权重引导搜索与稠密优先距离剪枝。
AI.motivation: 现有混合检索系统分别搜索稠密与稀疏索引并对候选并集重排，导致两次检索开销，且会丢弃仅在语义与词法信号融合后才排名靠前的项，产生过早候选损失；而直接在混合距离下构建单一静态图又无法适应随查询变化的混合权重。
AI.method: 1）UniGraph：将多个混合权重下计算的邻居集合合并为一个有界度图索引，使同一索引可服务不同查询权重；2）自适应权重引导搜索框架：依据查询权重在稀疏引导与稠密引导入口点之间选择；3）稠密优先的混合距离剪枝策略，避免不必要的精确稀疏距离计算。
AI.result: 不同查询权重下均取得较优的 Recall-QPS 权衡；在混合权重设置中，当 Recall@100 ≥ 0.95 时，UniGraph 在各数据集上的 QPS 比最快基线高 27.6%~52.3%；已在蚂蚁集团生产环境大规模部署。
AI.conclusion: UniGraph 以单一有界度图索引统一支持动态查询权重的混合检索，兼顾召回与吞吐，并已在实际大规模生产场景中验证其价值。

title: Earth World Model: Physics-constrained latent dynamics for forecasting and environmental scenario analysis
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables; includes Supplementary Information
summary: World models have been widely applied to multi-agent planning and forecasting, but exogenous environmental changes are rarely incorporated as replaceable drivers in a unified state-evolution process. This limits assessment of whether environmental perturbations propagate through physical systems with faithful dynamics. We propose the Earth World Model (EWM), an Earth-centred forecasting framework that compresses heterogeneous multi-source observations into a reusable low-dimensional latent state representing the system's history and current condition. Given explicit exogenous drivers, a shared transition operator recursively updates the latent state, and physics-constrained decoding produces multi-step forecasts. Replacing the drivers enables environmental scenario analysis and evaluation of dynamic-response fidelity. We evaluated EWM for power forecasting and environmental-perturbation response at six photovoltaic sites and one wind-power site. Across four photovoltaic sites and three forecast horizons, three independent training runs yielded mean $R^2$ values of 0.8578-0.9095. In a separate six-site decoder ablation, the mean net per-unit response $ρ$ under the prescribed irradiance intervention increased from 0.180 with a multilayer perceptron decoder to 0.922 with an analytic physical decoder, close to site- and horizon-specific analytic references. The wind model achieved an injection elasticity of $0.9990 \pm 0.0006$, while pre-intervention outputs remained unchanged. These results show that forecast fit and intervention response should be evaluated separately and that the tested EWM configurations preserved response amplitude and temporal boundaries under the prescribed interventions.

AI.tldr: 提出地球世界模型（EWM），将异构多源观测压缩为可复用的低维潜状态，以显式外源驱动和共享转移算子递归演化并物理约束解码，实现可替换驱动的情景分析与动态响应保真评估。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型用于多智能体预测时，外源环境变化很少作为可替换驱动纳入统一状态演化过程，难以评估环境扰动是否以忠实动力学在物理系统中传播。
AI.method: 构建以地球为中心的预测框架：将异构多源观测编码为表征系统历史与当前状态的低维潜变量；给定显式外源驱动，由共享转移算子递归更新潜状态；采用物理约束解码生成多步预测；通过替换驱动实现环境情景分析与响应保真度评估。
AI.result: 在6个光伏站点和1个风电场评估。4个光伏站点×3个预测时程、3次独立训练，平均R²为0.8578–0.9095。六站点解码器消融中，规定辐照干预下平均净单位响应ρ由MLP解码器的0.180提升至解析物理解码器的0.922，接近站点与时程特定的解析参考值。风电模型注入弹性为0.9990±0.0006，干预前输出保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 预测拟合度与干预响应应分开评估；所测试的EWM配置在规定干预下保持了响应幅度与时间边界的一致性。

title: Learning inadequacy of Bayesian neural operators for PDE-constrained inference and design
summary: Partial differential equations (PDEs) underpin predictive modeling across science, engineering and medicine. Their use in digital twins, parameter inference and optimal design requires repeated solutions across parameters and scenarios. For nonlinear, transient and multiphysics systems, these calculations can make numerical simulation prohibitively expensive. Here we introduce the residual-informed Bayesian neural operator (RI-BNO), which learns operator inadequacy using a posteriori error estimates from the governing PDEs and incorporates its correction and uncertainty into Bayesian training and prediction. We establish local error bounds for the residual-informed estimates under stability and smoothness assumptions. We demonstrate RI-BNO on a non-linear reaction-diffusion benchmark with DeepONet and latent-subspace architectures, Markov chain Monte Carlo inference of glioma parameter fields from magnetic resonance imaging, and Monte Carlo risk-averse optimization of three-dimensional thermal breaks in building envelopes under manufacturing uncertainty. Across the evaluated examples, RI-BNO improves agreement with finite element (FE) reference predictions, parameter posteriors and optimized designs while using half as many full nonlinear or transient training simulations as the vanilla Bayesian neural operator (vBNO). For thermal break design, online optimization time decreases from 178 hours with the FE model to 18 minutes with RI-BNO. These results demonstrate the value of explicit inadequacy modeling in neural operators for reliable PDE-based inference and design.

AI.tldr: 提出残差信息贝叶斯神经算子（RI-BNO），利用PDE后验误差估计显式建模算子不足，并将其校正项与不确定性纳入贝叶斯训练与预测，从而以更少的全阶仿真实现可靠的PDE推断与设计。
AI.motivation: 非线性、瞬态与多物理PDE在数字孪生、参数推断与优化设计中需反复求解，传统数值仿真代价过高；而神经算子作为代理模型存在算子不足（模型误差）问题，影响可靠性。
AI.method: RI-BNO以控制方程的后验误差估计（残差）为信息，学习算子不足的校正及其不确定性，融入贝叶斯训练与预测；在稳定性与光滑性假设下建立局部误差界；在非线性反应扩散基准（DeepONet与潜空间架构）、基于MRI的胶质瘤参数场MCMC推断、以及制造不确定性下三维建筑围护结构热桥的蒙特卡洛风险规避优化中验证。
AI.result: 在评估案例中，RI-BNO对有限元参考预测、参数后验与优化设计的一致性均提升，且所用全阶非线性/瞬态训练仿真仅为朴素贝叶斯神经算子（vBNO）的一半；热桥设计在线优化时间由FE的178小时降至18分钟。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模算子不足对神经算子在可靠的PDE推断与设计中具有重要价值。

title: Evidence Diet: When Graph Evidence Helps LLMs Rank Competing Candidates
summary: When several candidates have graph support, does it matter which candidate receives which supporter and path counts? We study how LLM rankers use collaborative evidence on Amazon Books and MovieTV. Swapping user-level evidence degrades ranking, while matched item substitutions have little effect. On fixed clean-trained checkpoints, unrelated catalog text lowers Hit@1 from 44.77% to 38.70%, with 99.9% of rankings still valid. Across all three paired seeds, the NDCG@5 difference between count and path prompts was larger after count training than after path training. Degree matching preserves target paths while giving more rivals support. Across the full degree-matched development pools, adding candidate-level graph records to history improves NDCG@5 by 2.28 points on Books and 2.54 on MovieTV. When the target and a rival both have support, path- and count-trained rankers benefit from retaining counts. On these development queries, adding counts numerically to history scores outperforms presenting them as text. For count-trained rankers, exchanging intact count pairs among supported candidates preserves support and token length, yet lowers NDCG@5 by 4.06 points on 141 Books queries and 3.26 on 104 MovieTV queries. A frozen evaluation on 274 previously unused Books users with supported targets and rivals confirms the attribution effect: correct assignment improves pairwise accuracy by 6.07 percentage points (95% CI [4.18, 8.00]).

AI.tldr: 研究LLM排序器如何使用图协同证据：用户级证据不可互换、候选级计数可增补、且计数须正确归属到对应候选才能带来收益。
AI.motivation: 作者关心排序中"哪个候选获得哪些支持者与路径计数"是否有实质影响，即协同证据的分配方式（assignment）与形式（计数/路径、文本/数值）如何影响LLM排序器表现。
AI.method: 在Amazon Books与MovieTV上对LLM排序器做受控扰动实验：交换用户级证据、替换匹配物品、注入无关目录文本（干净训练检查点）、在三个配对随机种子上训练count与path提示的排序器、采用degree matching以保持目标路径同时增加对手支持、在全度匹配开发池上向历史加入候选级图记录、以及对已支持候选间交换完整计数对；最后在274个未使用Books用户上做冻结评估。
AI.result: 交换用户级证据导致排序下降，而匹配物品替换影响很小；无关目录文本使Hit@1由44.77%降至38.70%，但99.9%的排序仍有效；三个配对种子下count训练后的count/path提示NDCG@5差异大于path训练后；加入候选级图记录使NDCG@5在Books提升2.28、MovieTV提升2.54；交换完整计数对使NDCG@5分别下降4.06（141条Books查询）和3.26（104条MovieTV查询）；冻结评估中正确归属使成对准确率提升6.07个百分点（95% CI [4.18, 8.00]）。
AI.conclusion: LLM排序器对协同证据的使用具有归属敏感性：证据的"谁给谁"比其表面形式更关键，计数可作为数值特征增补历史分数，但必须正确分配到对应候选；训练提示类型会改变模型对计数与路径证据的依赖。

title: The Human Side of ML Engineering: Analyzing the Collaboration and Communication Skills in ML Job Postings
summary: Studies of Machine Learning (ML) practice highlight the importance of combining technical expertise with interpersonal capabilities, particularly collaboration and communication. However, evidence on how ML job postings express these skills is scarce, and prior work largely relies on keyword-based analyses that overlook implicit expression. We analyze demand for these skills in ML job postings across regions, industries, and seniority levels, and compare it with software engineering (SE) roles. We collected 1,000 postings (500 ML, 500 SE) from five continents via a semi-automated pipeline. For annotation, we synthesized a taxonomy of collaboration and communication sub-categories from prior work and used an LLM as a third annotator alongside two humans, enabling detection of context-dependent and implicit skill references. Collaboration appeared in 88.6% of ML postings and communication in 72.2%, far above prior keyword-based estimates for AI roles. Roughly one in five collaboration and one in four communication requirements were expressed only implicitly. Decomposing these requirements into the taxonomy's sub-categories reveals what aggregate figures conceal. Collaboration is demanded predominantly as integration across role boundaries rather than team membership. Communication is mostly required in generic terms, with fewer than half of the postings requiring it naming whom the candidate must communicate with. ML and SE postings demand interpersonal competence at statistically indistinguishable levels but orient it differently, SE toward team practices and ML toward presentation and audience-facing interaction. Within ML, the advertised role separates interpersonal profiles more sharply than any other dimension, including the contrast with SE.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过半自动化流程跨五大洲采集1000条ML与SE岗位招聘信息，结合人工与LLM三重标注，发现ML岗位对协作（88.6%）和沟通（72.2%）能力的需求远超关键词估计，且相当比例为隐式表达。
AI.motivation: 既有研究强调ML实践需结合技术专长与人际能力（协作与沟通），但关于招聘广告如何表达这些技能的证据稀缺，且以往分析多依赖关键词匹配，忽略了隐式表达，导致需求被系统性低估。
AI.method: 采集五大洲1000条招聘信息（ML 500条、SE 500条）；基于既有工作合成协作与沟通子类分类体系；采用两名人工标注者加一个LLM作为第三标注者的三重标注方案，以识别依赖语境及隐式的技能表述；并按地区、行业、资历层级分解分析，与SE角色对比。
AI.result: 协作出现于88.6%的ML岗位、沟通出现于72.2%，显著高于既有AI岗位关键词估计；约五分之一的协作要求与四分之一的沟通要求仅以隐式方式表达。协作主要被要求为跨角色边界的集成而非团队归属；沟通多为笼统表述，不足半数岗位指明沟通对象。ML与SE的人际能力需求强度统计上无差异，但取向不同：SE偏向团队实践，ML偏向展示与面向受众的互动。ML内部，岗位角色对人际能力画像的区分度高于其他任何维度（含与SE的对比）。
AI.conclusion: 关键词法显著低估ML岗位的人际能力需求，细分分类体系揭示了聚合数字所掩盖的结构差异；ML与SE需求相当但指向不同，且岗位角色是ML内部分化人际能力要求的最强维度。

title: Beveridge: Open Weight System One Decision Models with Calibrated Probabilities
summary: Many production systems need a model to make a narrow decision about a document (route a ticket, check a limit, refuse a request, pick the next step of a browser agent) rather than to write text about it. We present Beveridge, a family of open weight System One decision models that take a document and up to 15 typed questions (yes/no, choice among described options, or a level on an ordered scale) and return, in one forward pass without generating text, an answer with a calibrated probability for every option. Beveridge-Large-C (398M parameters) adds a 3.5M parameter decision network to ModernBERT-large: typed number and date features in the input, exact facts from a rule engine, question-to-document evidence attention, a three-step recursive core with learned halting and an exact yes/no path. Beveridge-Pro-C adapts Gemma 4 26B-A4B with LoRA to score option letters, and Beveridge-Pro-C-Web extends it to the next step of a browser agent. On held-out tests the 0.4B model reaches 93.0% on our operations-document benchmark against 91.1% for the best of five general LLMs (31B-675B) and 87.9% for a commercial System One API, and, because its confidences are calibrated (ECE 0.029 on that benchmark), it can hand over 76% of decisions automatically at 95% accuracy, where no general LLM we tested can hand over any. It answers in 4.9 ms per decision on one NVIDIA H200 GPU and 60 ms on the 14 core CPU of an Apple M4 Pro laptop. Beveridge-Pro-C-Web raises next-step accuracy on web pages from unseen site types from 49.4% to 98.2% and completes live browsing tasks without losing document accuracy. We describe the models, the training recipes and an evaluation on 19 held-out test sets against a commercial System One API and five general LLMs, including where the models are weak. Weights and inference code are released under Apache 2.0.

AI.tldr: 提出 Beveridge 系列开放权重 System One 决策模型，单次前向传播对文档回答至多15个类型化问题并给出校准概率，0.4B 模型在运维文档基准上超越多个通用大模型与商业 API，并可高比例自动移交。
AI.motivation: 许多生产系统需要的不是生成文本，而是对文档做出窄决策（工单路由、限额核查、请求拒绝、浏览器智能体下一步），现有通用 LLM 在此类任务上准确率与置信度校准不足，难以自动化移交。
AI.method: Beveridge-Large-C：在 ModernBERT-large 上外加 3.5M 参数决策网络，含输入中的类型化数字/日期特征、规则引擎精确事实、问题—文档证据注意力、带学习式停机（learned halting）的三步递归核心及精确 yes/no 路径；Beveridge-Pro-C 用 LoRA 适配 Gemma 4 26B-A4B 对选项字母打分，Pro-C-Web 扩展至浏览器智能体下一步预测。
AI.result: 运维文档基准上 0.4B 模型达 93.0%，优于五个通用 LLM（31B–675B）中最佳的 91.1% 与商业 System One API 的 87.9%；ECE 0.029，可在 95% 准确率下自动移交 76% 决策（通用 LLM 无法移交任何决策）；单卡 H200 推理 4.9 ms/决策，Apple M4 Pro 14 核 CPU 上 60 ms；Pro-C-Web 将未见站点类型的网页下一步准确率从 49.4% 提升至 98.2%，且不损失文档准确率。
AI.conclusion: 在 19 个留出测试集上对比商业 System One API 与五个通用 LLM，并说明了模型弱点；权重与推理代码以 Apache 2.0 发布。

title: A Hybrid State Space-Attention Architecture for Forecasting the Trajectories of Battery Degradation
summary: Early-life battery degradation trajectory forecasting aims to predict a battery cell's full state-of-health (SOH) trajectory from its initial charge-discharge cycles, potentially reducing cell qualification and evaluation time from months to days. Despite recent advances, accurate forecasting remains challenging for emerging battery chemistries, data-scarce domains, and cells exhibiting degradation behaviors beyond those observed during training. Existing state-of-the-art approaches increasingly rely on model scaling, large language model-derived aging-condition embeddings, and extensive fold-specific hyperparameter tuning, raising concerns about computational efficiency, reproducibility, and generalization. This work introduces DecayFormer, a compact hybrid state-space and attention architecture designed for early-life degradation trajectory forecasting. DecayFormer combines cycle-level selective recurrence, using a single scalar state per channel, with an attention mechanism queried by the recurrent state. It further incorporates state-of-charge (SOC) interval statistics and a master curve head that jointly estimates a scalar lifetime and a monotonically non-increasing SOH profile parameterized by normalized lifetime. We evaluate DecayFormer on the BatteryLife benchmark using all 22 aging-condition-exclusive folds, with a single run per fold and one fixed configuration across all folds, without fold-specific tuning. DecayFormer achieves mean test MAPE values of 2.25% on Li-ion, 2.76% on CALB, 0.95% on Na-ion, and 7.19% on Zn-ion. These results demonstrate the potential of compact sequence models to deliver accurate early-life degradation forecasts across diverse battery chemistries and aging conditions, without relying on extensive model scaling or per-fold optimization.

AI.tldr: 该文提出DecayFormer——一种紧凑的混合状态空间与注意力架构，仅需早期循环即可预测电池全生命周期SOH轨迹；在BatteryLife基准的22个老化条件排他折上，单一固定配置、每折仅运行一次即取得Li-ion 2.25%、CALB 2.76%、Na-ion 0.95%、Zn-ion 7.19%的平均测试MAPE，证明紧凑序列模型可在无需模型规模化与逐折调参的情况下实现跨化学体系的高精度早期寿命预测。
AI.motivation: 早期寿命SOH轨迹预测可将电芯合格性评估时间从数月缩短至数天。然而现有SOTA方法依赖模型规模化、基于大语言模型的老化条件嵌入以及大量逐折（fold-specific）超参数调优，导致计算效率低、可复现性差、泛化性存疑，且在新兴化学体系、数据稀缺域及训练中未见的退化行为上表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出DecayFormer，紧凑的混合状态空间-注意力架构：1）循环级选择性递归，每通道仅用单一标量状态；2）以递归状态作为query的注意力机制；3）引入SOC区间统计特征；4）master curve头，联合估计标量寿命与以归一化寿命为参数的单调非增SOH曲线。
AI.result: 在BatteryLife基准全部22个老化条件排他折上评估，每折单次运行、全局单一固定配置、无逐折调参。平均测试MAPE：Li-ion 2.25%，CALB 2.76%，Na-ion 0.95%，Zn-ion 7.19%。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑序列模型能够在多种电池化学体系与老化条件下提供准确的早期退化预测，且不依赖大规模模型扩展或逐折优化，为高效、可复现的电池寿命预测提供了可行路径。

title: EE-Motion: An EEG-based Web Architecture for Live Affective Music Recommendation
summary: Music listening is intrinsically tied to emotion, which drifts continuously within a single session. Although modern browsers interface with wearable brain-computer interfaces, recommendation systems remain structured around discrete logs and lack the infrastructure to integrate continuous physiological signals. Furthermore, existing affect-aware models rely on static user profiles and offline training, failing to serve anonymous newcomers without model retraining. We present a web platform that resolves both challenges. Pairing with a consumer electroencephalogram (EEG) headband over Web Bluetooth, the system captures live EEG, mapping frontal alpha asymmetry and arousal index to normalized valence-arousal proxy coordinates on Russell's circumplex plane. Driven by these coordinates, an affective adapter unifies structurally diverse recommendation backbones under a shared live scoring mechanism. By parameterizing anonymous visitors through a few favorite tracks, the module recommends tracks conditioned on live proxy coordinates. This demonstrates that real-time EEG-derived control signals can steer recommendations without persistent user tables or model retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个网页平台，通过Web Bluetooth连接消费级EEG头环，实时将前额alpha不对称性与唤醒指数映射为Russell环状模型上的归一化效价-唤醒代理坐标，并用情感适配器统一多种推荐骨干模型，在无需持久用户表或模型重训的情况下实现实时脑电驱动的音乐推荐。
AI.motivation: 音乐聆听中的情绪在单次会话内持续漂移，但推荐系统仍基于离散日志构建，缺乏融合连续生理信号的基础设施；同时现有情感感知模型依赖静态用户画像与离线训练，无法服务无模型重训条件下的匿名新用户。
AI.method: 构建网页平台：经Web Bluetooth与消费级EEG头环配对采集实时脑电，提取前额alpha不对称性与唤醒指数，映射为Russell环状平面上的归一化效价-唤醒代理坐标；设计情感适配器，将结构异构的推荐骨干模型统一到共享的实时打分机制下；通过少量收藏曲目参数化匿名访客。
AI.result: 系统在匿名访客场景下以实时代理坐标为条件生成推荐，证明实时EEG衍生控制信号可在无持久用户表、无模型重训的前提下引导推荐结果。
AI.conclusion: 实时脑电驱动的连续情感信号可作为推荐系统的控制输入，绕过传统离散日志与静态画像范式，为浏览器端可穿戴BCI与情感感知推荐的一体化提供了可行路径。

title: ECOD: Experience-Calibrated On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents
summary: Sparse and delayed rewards make reinforcement learning challenging for long-horizon language agents. On-policy distillation (OPD) complements environmental rewards with dense teacher feedback on student-generated contexts. Standard OPD can misalign supervision with relative teacher competence, student trajectory outcomes, and the temporal structure of task execution. Recent variants adjust guidance through divergence-based weighting and temporal schedules, while joint calibration from task-completion experience remains underexplored. We introduce Experience-Calibrated On-Policy Distillation (ECOD), which allocates teacher supervision at the task, trajectory, and turn levels. ECOD compares teacher and student success-rate posteriors under matched task conditions, restricts direct supervision to failed student trajectories, and derives a temporal prior from successful teacher lengths. The resulting weight applies to teacher losses or teacher-derived advantages. We evaluate ECOD on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Under matched teacher settings, ECOD improves standard OPD by up to 4.06% in relative ALFWorld unseen success. Across both model scales, ECOD-assisted SOD, TCOD-F2B, and ATOD configurations yield average paired relative gains of 6.20% on ALFWorld unseen and 7.05% on WebShop, with WebShop gains ranging from 2.29% to 21.60%. These results support experience-calibrated supervision allocation as a reusable mechanism across distinct distillation objectives.

AI.tldr: 提出Experience-Calibrated On-Policy Distillation（ECOD），在任务、轨迹、轮次三个层级分配教师监督，利用成功率后验与成功教师长度先验校准权重，在ALFWorld与WebShop上稳定提升在线策略蒸馏效果。
AI.motivation: 长程语言智能体面临稀疏且延迟的奖励；在线策略蒸馏（OPD）虽提供稠密教师反馈，但标准OPD的监督权重与教师相对能力、学生轨迹结果以及任务执行的时间结构不匹配。现有变体仅做散度加权与时间调度调整，缺乏对任务完成经验的联合校准。
AI.method: ECOD三层加权：(1) 任务层——在匹配任务条件下比较教师与学生的成功率后验，衡量教师相对胜任度；(2) 轨迹层——仅对失败的student轨迹施加直接监督；(3) 轮次层——由成功教师轨迹长度导出时间先验。所得权重作用于教师损失或教师派生优势，可即插即用于SOD、TCOD-F2B、ATOD等蒸馏目标。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld与WebShop上，用Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct与Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct评测：同等教师设置下，ECOD相对标准OPD在ALFWorld unseen成功率上最高提升4.06%（相对值）；跨两种模型规模，ECOD辅助的SOD、TCOD-F2B与ATOD平均配对相对增益为ALFWorld unseen 6.20%、WebShop 7.05%，WebShop增益区间2.29%–21.60%。
AI.conclusion: 经验校准的监督分配是一种可跨不同蒸馏目标复用的通用机制，能有效提升长程语言智能体的在线策略蒸馏性能。

title: Agent-Guided Process Verification for Mathematical Self-Correction
summary: Large language models have made substantial progress in mathematical reasoning, yet in complex multi-step reasoning, an error at any step may propagate along an incorrect path, and the resulting solution may omit necessary branches. Existing natural-language reflection methods often struggle to locate critical errors precisely, while outcome verification typically checks only whether the available candidate answers satisfy the problem conditions and can therefore overlook necessary branches. To address these limitations, we propose Agent-Guided Process Verification (AGPV) for mathematical self-correction. AGPV decomposes the current solution into an ordered sequence of key claims, verifies them individually while invoking a shared mathematical toolbox when needed, and stops upon detecting the first error. A summarization agent converts the failure evidence into a diagnosis that guides a correction agent to re-derive the subsequent solution from that point; AGPV then adapts the next verification iteration to the revised solution. AGPV also verifies solution completeness. We further prove that AGPV guarantees solution correctness and completeness when key claims provide sufficient coverage and local verification is reliable, provided that all key claims pass verification. The implementation compresses long working contexts and reuses successful tool results within each problem. We evaluate AGPV on five challenging mathematical reasoning datasets with four models from DeepSeek, Qwen, and GPT. AGPV achieves an average accuracy of 63.8%, outperforming the strongest among the representative baselines evaluated (50.3%) by 13.5 percentage points, with higher repair coverage than the programmatic-verification baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出Agent-Guided Process Verification (AGPV)框架，对数学解答的关键论断进行有序过程验证，定位首个错误并生成诊断指导局部重推，同时校验解答完整性，在五个数学推理数据集上将平均准确率提升至63.8%，比最强基线高13.5个百分点。
AI.motivation: 复杂多步数学推理中，任一步骤错误会沿错误路径传播，且最终解答可能遗漏必要分支。现有自然语言反思难以精确定位关键错误；结果级验证只检查候选答案是否满足题目条件，因而容易忽略必要分支（完整性不足）。
AI.method: 将当前解答分解为有序的关键论断序列，逐条独立验证，必要时调用共享数学工具箱，遇首个错误即停止；由总结代理（summarization agent）把失败证据转化为诊断，指导修正代理从该点重新推导后续解答；下一轮验证迭代自适应调整以适配修改后的解答；此外增加解答完整性验证。实现层面压缩长工作上下文并在同一题内复用成功的工具调用结果。理论上证明：当关键论断覆盖充分、局部验证可靠且全部论断通过时，AGPV保证解答的正确性与完整性。
AI.result: 在五个高难度数学推理数据集、DeepSeek/Qwen/GPT的四个模型上评估，AGPV平均准确率63.8%，较代表性基线中最强者（50.3%）高13.5个百分点，且修复覆盖率高于程序化验证类基线。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度过程验证加诊断驱动的局部重推，优于自然语言反思与结果级验证，能在保证正确性的同时兼顾解答完整性，为数学自纠正提供了可证明有效且工程可行的方案。

title: ExRel: Learning Directed Reuse Relevance between Rich-Text K-12 Question Images with Executable Relation Contracts
summary: In K-12 education, question images combine text, mathematical expressions, diagrams, and diverse layouts. Variations in wording, conditions, answer options, or task scope can substantially alter their reuse utility despite visual similarity. We formulate this problem as directed reuse relevance, grading candidate utility as Strong, Medium, or Weak. However, generic similarity scores overlook task-specific reuse requirements, while natural supervision is dominated by Strong relations and lacks fine-grained coverage. We propose ExRel, an agentic, code-grounded framework for controllable and verifiable visual data synthesis. It reconstructs real questions into editable HTML/CSS seeds and compiles 15 relation subtypes into executable contracts specifying permitted edits, protected invariants, and query-candidate direction. Synthesized pairs undergo deterministic DOM/render validation and target-hidden, evidence-assisted review, with bounded repair before mild photographic degradation. Only rendered images are used for downstream training. Experiments show that ExRel supervision outperforms size-matched natural data and count- and class-matched replay, particularly on Medium relations, while maintaining comparable query-level ranking performance and improving robustness to visual degradation. Construction ablations demonstrate higher valid yield and fewer false admissions than less structured baselines. Human audits confirm 98.0% post-admission validity, while ExRel achieves a lower per-accepted-pair cost than outsourced annotation (0.70 vs. 1.10 RMB). Downstream answer routing further demonstrates the practical utility of the synthesized supervision.

AI.tldr: ExRel：面向K-12题目图像的可控、可验证视觉数据合成框架，将真实题目重构为可编辑HTML/CSS种子，并把15种复用关系子类型编译为可执行契约，生成强/中/弱三档定向复用监督信号，优于同规模自然数据与重放基线。
AI.motivation: K-12题目图像融合文本、公式、图示与多样版式，措辞、条件、选项或任务范围的细微变化会显著改变其复用价值，视觉相似不代表可复用；而通用相似度分数忽视任务特定的复用需求，自然监督又严重偏向"强"关系、缺乏细粒度覆盖。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为有向复用相关性（Strong/Medium/Weak三档）。提出ExRel：agentic、代码落地的合成框架，把真实题目重建为可编辑HTML/CSS种子，将15类关系子类型编译为可执行契约（规定允许编辑、受保护不变量、查询-候选方向）；合成对经确定性DOM/渲染校验与目标隐藏、证据辅助的评审，有限次修复后进行轻度摄影退化，仅用渲染图像做下游训练。
AI.result: ExRel监督优于同规模自然数据及数量/类别匹配的重放，在Medium关系上提升尤为明显；查询级排序性能相当，且对视觉退化更鲁棒。构建消融显示更高有效产出率与更少误纳；人工审核确认准入后有效率98.0%；每对接受样本成本低于外包标注（0.70 vs 1.10 元）。下游答案路由验证了其实用价值。
AI.conclusion: 基于代码落地的契约式合成可提供可控、可验证且低成本的细粒度复用监督，弥补自然数据在Medium关系上的覆盖不足，并兼具鲁棒性与经济性。

title: SART: Sign-Absolute Reformulation Theory for Binary Variable Reduction in Neural Network Verification
summary: Complete formal verification of neural networks is crucial for their deployment in safety-critical domains. A key bottleneck stems from encoding complexity: traditional methods assign one binary variable per unstable ReLU neuron. We propose the Sign-Absolute Reformulation Theory (SART), which fundamentally breaks the conventional one-to-one mapping between unstable neurons and binary variables by establishing formal reducibility criteria. This allows for finer-grained modeling, where each unstable neuron corresponds on average to fewer than one binary variable, thereby reducing verification complexity at its source. Based on SART, we derive a theoretical lower bound on the number of binary variables required for complete verification and, under the assumption that $P \neq NP$, prove that variables in the final layer can be compressed by 50\%, while the number of variables in intermediate layers cannot be further reduced. To overcome the apparent ``last-layer-only'' limitation, we recast verification as a sequential process and, crucially, show that the gain lifts to the entire network: LayerABS, a SART-based progressive tightening verifier, iteratively treats intermediate layers as temporary final layers and propagates tight bounds that shrink the global search space and binary-variable counts. Furthermore, we reveal a structural law influencing verification complexity: when the signs of weights of unstable neurons satisfy numerical symmetry, with positive and negative weights equal or differing by at most one, the worst-case verification complexity achieves the theoretical optimum, offering theoretical guidance for the design of verification-friendly architectures. As a general-purpose underlying encoding, the value of SART is independent of specific algorithms.

AI.tldr: 提出符号-绝对值重构理论(SART)，打破不稳定ReLU神经元与二值变量的一一对应，推导完整验证所需二值变量的理论下界，并据此设计LayerABS渐进收紧验证器，将最后一层的压缩增益推广到整个网络。
AI.motivation: 神经网络完整形式验证的瓶颈在于编码复杂度：传统方法为每个不稳定ReLU神经元分配一个二值变量，导致验证复杂度高。
AI.method: SART建立形式化可归约准则，实现单神经元对应平均少于一个二值变量的细粒度建模；推导完整验证所需二值变量数的理论下界，并在P≠NP假设下证明最后一层变量可压缩50%、中间层不可再压缩；将验证重构为序列过程，提出LayerABS——以SART为基础、迭代将中间层视为临时最后层并传播紧界以收缩全局搜索空间与变量数的渐进收紧验证器；同时揭示权重符号的数值对称性对最坏情况复杂度的影响规律。
AI.result: 在P≠NP假设下，最后层二值变量可压缩50%，中间层变量数无法进一步减少；LayerABS使压缩增益从最后一层扩展到整个网络；当不稳定神经元权重正负号数量相等或相差至多一时，最坏情况验证复杂度达到理论最优。
AI.conclusion: SART作为通用底层编码，其价值与具体算法无关；它从源头降低验证复杂度，并为可验证友好架构设计提供理论指导。

title: FundingClaw: Automated Grant Proposal Writing Agents System
summary: Grant proposal writing remains a manual, labor-intensive bottleneck: proposals must satisfy rigid, agency-specific templates, and the same intellectual content must be repeatedly re-encoded into incompatible formats across funding organizations. We introduce FundingClaw, a multi-agent framework built on template-driven skill selection, where a Template Parser ingests any agency's specification and selects the appropriate writing skills for each stage, so that one research brief can produce compliant proposals for NSFC, NSF, KAKENHI, or ERC without modifying generation logic. A blueprint-skeleton strategy drafts a structured outline before any prose is written, mitigating the semantic drift that plagues long-form generation. Three sequential stages produce the rationale, research content, and research foundation sections, with multi-source verification of the PI's record and optional PDF-grounded extraction of representative works. Optional human feedback checkpoints and a closed-loop self-review complete the pipeline. Evaluated on ten research topics with an eight-dimension rubric, FundingClaw outperforms the baseline, narrowing the gap with human level for laborious funding proposal. The code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出 FundingClaw 多智能体框架，通过模板驱动的技能选择实现跨机构（NSFC/NSF/KAKENHI/ERC）基金申请书自动生成。
AI.motivation: 基金申请书撰写高度依赖人工且耗时；各资助机构模板僵化且互不兼容，同一研究内容需反复重新编码为不同格式，形成效率瓶颈。
AI.method: 核心为模板驱动的技能选择机制：Template Parser 解析任意机构规范并为各阶段选取相应写作技能，使单一研究简介可生成合规提案而无需修改生成逻辑；采用 blueprint-skeleton 策略先起草结构化大纲再撰写正文以缓解长文本生成的语义漂移；三个阶段依次生成研究依据、研究内容与研究基础，配合 PI 履历的多源核验与可选的代表作 PDF 接地的抽取；另有可选人工反馈检查点与闭环自审。
AI.result: 在十个研究主题上以八维评分量表评估，FundingClaw 优于基线，缩小了与人类水平的差距。
AI.conclusion: 模板驱动技能选择与大纲先行策略可有效支撑跨机构的合规长文生成；代码将在录用后开源。

title: Knowledge-Guided Local-to-Global Anomaly Learning for Longitudinal Medication Trajectories
summary: Detecting suspicious deviations in longitudinal medication trajectories requires distinguishing knowledge-consistent treatment variations from anomalous changes and linking local deviations to account-level decisions. We propose a knowledge-guided local-to-global (L2G) anomaly learning framework that addresses both challenges. It constructs proxy supervision at three granularities: medication occurrences, treatment episodes, and contiguous visit segments. Knowledge-consistent medication and episode replacements provide plausible negatives, while cross-category and cross-account perturbations provide suspicious proxies. A medication-multiset encoder and causal visit-sequence encoder feed a shared scoring head that produces visit-level anomaly logits. Top-\(α\) aggregation derives account-level scores from these logits, while account-level classification and class-balanced visit-localization objectives jointly optimize the same visit-level evidence. Experiments on two city cohorts compare L2G with native and proxy-adapted anomaly methods. On City-A, L2G outperforms the strongest comparators. Cross-city results show more consistent gains in localization than in account-level detection.

AI.tldr: 知识引导的L2G框架在三粒度构件代理监督，用访问级异常logits联合优化账户分类与定位
AI.motivation: 纵向用药轨迹中的可疑偏差检测需区分知识一致的治疗变化与真正异常，并将局部偏差归因到账户级决策
AI.method: 构建药物出现、治疗片段、连续就诊片段三粒度代理监督：知识一致的药物/片段替换作可信负样本，跨类别与跨账户扰动作可疑代理；药物多重集编码器与因果就诊序列编码器共享打分头输出访问级异常logits，Top-α聚合得账户级分数，账户分类与类别平衡访问定位联合优化
AI.result: 在两个城市队列上与原生及代理适配异常方法对比；City-A上优于最强基线；跨城市实验显示定位增益比账户级检测更稳定一致
AI.conclusion: 代理监督与局部到全局聚合有效提升轨迹异常检测，定位任务迁移性优于账户级判定

title: Rethinking the Verification of Machine Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning claims require evidence that a model has removed the influence of specified training data. Yet widely deployable post hoc verifiers. infer unlearning largely from predictive behavior, the final model response that remains under the provider's control. We make this limitation concrete through Output-Level Deceptive Response (ODR), an attack that produces responses accepted by output based verifiers while preserving the original representation state. By separating output conformity from internal unlearning, ODR motivates a rethinking of machine unlearning verification, shifting the audit target from what the model returns to what changes inside it. We operationalize this shift through Representation Unlearning Verification (RUV), a gray box verifier that compares intermediate forward representations in the original and unlearned models. RUV traces a four-stage response through activation reorganization, representation displacement, neighborhood disruption, and loss of manifold support. Matched retained controls distinguish target specific responses from global model drift, while joint permutation calibration combines the four evidence views into an adaptive decision. Experiments spanning exact and approximate unlearning, class and sample level requests, multiple datasets, and diverse architectures show mean ODR deception success rates of $97.0\%$ and $97.7\%$, respectively. RUV achieves mean verification accuracies of $98.9\%$ and $94.9\%$, while rejecting $99.5\%$ and $99.8\%$ of the corresponding ODR submissions.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示仅依赖输出行为的机器遗忘验证可被 Output-Level Deceptive Response (ODR) 攻击欺骗（成功率约97%），并提出灰盒的表示级验证方法 RUV，通过比较中间层表示变化并结合置换校准，实现约95%–99%的验证准确率且能拒绝绝大多数 ODR 提交。
AI.motivation: 现有可部署的事后遗忘验证器主要依据模型预测行为（输出）来推断是否遗忘，而输出仍处于提供方控制之下，因此这类验证存在根本性局限：输出符合"遗忘"并不等于内部表示真正移除了目标数据影响。
AI.method: 1) 提出 ODR 攻击，构造能通过输出级验证器、但保留原始表示状态的响应，以具体化上述局限；2) 提出 Representation Unlearning Verification (RUV)，一种灰盒验证器，比较原始模型与遗忘模型的前向中间表示；3) RUV 追踪四阶段响应：激活重组、表示位移、邻域扰动、流形支撑丧失；4) 用匹配的保留数据对照区分针对性响应与全局模型漂移；5) 通过联合置换校准将四类证据视图融合为自适应判决。
AI.result: 实验覆盖精确与近似遗忘、类别级与样本级请求、多数据集与多种架构：ODR 平均欺骗成功率分别为 97.0% 与 97.7%；RUV 平均验证准确率分别为 98.9% 与 94.9%，并分别拒绝 99.5% 与 99.8% 的对应 ODR 提交。
AI.conclusion: 机器遗忘验证的审计目标应从"模型返回什么"转向"模型内部发生了什么变化"；表示级灰盒验证 RUV 在保持较高验证准确率的同时，对输出级欺骗攻击具有强鲁棒性。

title: From Sensors to Silicon: Causal Cross-Layer Self-Healing Edge AI for Secure and Energy-Adaptive IoT Systems
summary: The migration of artificial intelligence from centralized cloud infrastructure to resource-constrained Internet-of-Things (IoT) devices reduces communication latency and improves data locality, but it also tightly couples sensing quality, inference behavior, microarchitectural activity, hardware reliability, security, and energy management within the same physical node. Existing edge-intelligence solutions predominantly address these dimensions in isolation, making it difficult to determine whether an observed degradation originates from sensor malfunction, data-distribution shift, malicious execution, hardware faults, or resource and thermal stress. This paper presents a causal cross-layer self-healing Edge-AI framework that continuously observes synchronized telemetry spanning sensor health, inference uncertainty, processor hardware-performance counters, accelerator and memory activity, power and thermal state, and communication conditions. A temporally informed causal reasoning engine estimates the most probable origin of abnormal behavior and quantifies diagnostic uncertainty, including under concurrent perturbations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种因果跨层自愈边缘智能框架，通过同步采集传感、推理、微架构、可靠性、安全与功耗热等多层遥测，用时间感知因果推理引擎定位异常根因并量化诊断不确定性。
AI.motivation: AI从云端迁移到资源受限IoT设备后，感知质量、推理行为、微架构活动、硬件可靠性、安全与能耗管理在同一物理节点上紧密耦合；现有边缘智能方案多维度孤立处理，难以判定性能退化究竟源于传感器故障、数据分布漂移、恶意执行、硬件故障还是资源/热应力。
AI.method: 构建因果跨层自愈边缘AI框架：连续观测跨层同步遥测（传感器健康、推理不确定性、处理器硬件性能计数器、加速器与内存活动、功耗与热状态、通信条件）；采用时间感知的因果推理引擎推断异常行为最可能的来源，并量化诊断不确定性（包括并发扰动情形）。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果，仅声明框架可在并发扰动下估计异常最可能起源并给出诊断不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨层遥测与因果推理的结合，将边缘AI的异常诊断从孤立维度提升到统一根因定位层面，为自愈能力提供可解释、可量化的诊断基础。

title: Stagewise Adaptive Boosting
summary: Stagewise algorithms and sparsity-inducing regularization are two influential approaches to high-dimensional modeling. Existing stagewise theory, however, largely centers on convex regularization, whereas stronger sparsity and other structural preferences are often pursued through fixed-level nonconvex optimization rather than generating an entire adaptive solution path. We develop stagewise adaptive boosting, a general framework that builds a monotone path by selecting the update consistent with structural preference. The framework can encourage sparsity along the path itself and also admits extensions that promote other properties of the solution, including group selection, similarity across models for multiple outcomes, and known priorities or prerequisite relations among predictors. We study its theoretical property as well as finite sample performance using simulations and real-data analyses. Across these studies, the proposed pathwise approach often achieves predictive performance comparable to commonly used baselines while selecting substantially smaller models. These results suggest that adaptive stagewise learning provides a practical route to stronger sparsity and richer structural control without repeatedly solving separate weighted or nonconvex optimization problems.

AI.tldr: 提出 stagewise adaptive boosting 框架，沿单调路径按结构偏好选择更新，实现稀疏、组选择、多结果相似性与变量优先关系的路径化控制。
AI.motivation: 现有 stagewise 理论主要针对凸正则，而更强稀疏性与其他结构偏好通常需通过固定水平的非凸优化实现，无法生成整条自适应解路径；且重复求解多个加权或非凸问题代价高。
AI.method: 构建通用 stagewise 自适应 boosting 框架：以单调方式逐步生成解路径，每步选择与结构偏好一致的更新；框架本身可沿路径诱导稀疏性，并可扩展至组选择、多结果模型间相似性、以及预测变量间的已知优先级/先决关系。
AI.result: 给出理论性质分析，并通过模拟与真实数据分析评估有限样本表现；所提路径方法预测性能常与常用基线相当，同时选出显著更小的模型。
AI.conclusion: 自适应 stagewise 学习无需反复求解独立的加权或非凸优化问题，即可实现更强稀疏性与更丰富的结构控制，是实用的建模途径。

title: LABEL: Literature Asymmetry between Efficacy and Limits in Drug Knowledge and Language Models
comment: 27 pages (9 main + supplementary material), 8 figures, 7 tables
summary: Every medication comes with two types of medical facts: indications, which describe what conditions the drug treats (benefits), and contraindications, which describe who must avoid it to prevent serious harm (safety limits). Although contraindications are critical for patient safety and FDA regulations require listing them as rigorously as indications, we find that contraindications are far less documented than indications in general prose. In this paper, we measure how often these texts contain both facts across 574 drugs from PrimeKG by comparing a drug's indications against its own contraindications. Across Wikipedia articles and PubMed abstracts, we find that reference prose names a drug's benefits about twice as often as its safety limits (within-drug odds ratio 2.19). We call this documentation gap LABEL (Literature Asymmetry between Efficacy and Limits). Language models mirror this gap. As we scale Qwen2.5 from 0.5B to 14B, accuracy on indications rises by 18.3 points, whereas accuracy on contraindications remains flat near random guessing. However, when we provide models with a retrieved passage that states the answer, they use safety facts just as effectively as benefits. Furthermore, routing safety questions to official FDA labels boosts accuracy by 15.8 points whenever the label states the fact. Overall, our findings show that models fail on medication safety not because they cannot reason about risk, but because free-text corpora lack safety facts. Clinical AI systems should therefore route medication-safety questions to official regulatory labels and structured databases rather than relying on general public records. Code and data are available at https://github.com/SMRayeed/LABEL.

AI.tldr: 论文提出并量化了"LABEL"现象：在自由文本语料（Wikipedia、PubMed）中，药物适应症（获益）的记载频率约为禁忌症（安全限制）的两倍，且语言模型继承了这一偏差，禁忌症准确率随规模几乎不提升；但只要提供检索到的事实，模型能同等有效地利用安全信息，说明失败源于语料缺失而非推理能力不足。
AI.motivation: 禁忌症对患者安全至关重要，FDA 也要求其与适应症同等严格地列示，但作者观察到通用叙述文本中禁忌症的记录远少于适应症。该不对称是否真实存在、是否传导至语言模型的药物安全表现，此前缺乏系统测量。
AI.method: 基于 PrimeKG 选取 574 种药物，对同一药物的适应症与其自身禁忌症进行配对比较（drug 内对照），在 Wikipedia 文章与 PubMed 摘要中统计两类事实出现的频率，用 drug 内优势比量化差异；并在 Qwen2.5（0.5B–14B）上评测两类事实的准确率随规模的变化；进一步开展检索段落提供与 FDA 官方标签路由实验。
AI.result: 参考文献文本命名药物获益的频率约为安全限制的两倍（drug 内 OR = 2.19）。Qwen2.5 从 0.5B 扩展到 14B，适应症准确率提升 18.3 个点，而禁忌症准确率基本维持在随机猜测水平。提供含答案的检索段落后，模型对安全事实的利用与获益事实同样有效；将安全问题路由到 FDA 官方标签，在标签包含该事实时准确率提升 15.8 个点。
AI.conclusion: 模型在用药安全上的失效并非源于无法推理风险，而是自由文本语料缺少安全事实。临床 AI 系统应将用药安全问题路由至官方监管标签与结构化数据库，而非依赖公开通用文本；应避免以通用语料的覆盖度衡量模型的安全知识。

title: Who Writes the Codebook? An Eight-Step Framework for Auditing LLM-Generated Category Systems
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly create the categories through which qualitative evidence is interpreted. Existing coding benchmarks often hold these categories fixed. We propose the Qualitative Variance Audit Framework, an eight-step method that compares codebook creation, repeated application and code distributions under controlled inputs. It combines model-owned and shared-reference codebooks to distinguish variation in the overall pipeline from application differences within a common category system. An application to 668 organisational interviews, 13,166 text units and eight models from five vendors yields 48 codebooks and 270 coding runs. Models create markedly different category structures; mean within-model reliability ranges from .76 to .92, whereas between-model agreement on the shared codebook is about .69. The framework complements LLM-assisted grounded theory by exposing model dependencies before substantive interpretation. It assesses reliability and representational consequences, not interpretive validity or the quality of resulting theory.

AI.tldr: 提出"质性变异审计框架"（八步方法），通过比较模型自建与共享参考码本下的码本创建、重复应用与编码分布，量化LLM在质性编码中的模型依赖性与可靠性。
AI.motivation: LLM日益参与创造质性证据解读所用的类别，但现有编码基准通常固定类别不变，无法揭示模型自身对类别体系的建构差异及其对结果的影响。
AI.method: 八步质性变异审计框架；结合"模型自有码本"与"共享参考码本"两种设置，在受控输入下比较码本创建、重复应用与编码分布，从而区分整体流程变异与同一类别体系内的应用差异。实证：668份组织访谈、13,166个文本单元、来自5家厂商的8个模型，生成48个码本、270次编码运行。
AI.result: 模型生成的类别结构差异显著；模型内平均信度为.76–.92，而共享码本上的模型间一致性约.69。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可作为LLM辅助扎根理论的补充，在实质性解读前暴露模型依赖性；其评估范围限于信度与表征后果，不涉及解释效度或所得理论的质量。

title: Can a Vision-Language Model Tune Clustering In Context?
summary: Clustering is a widely used unsupervised learning method, but selecting an appropriate algorithm and set of hyperparameters for a specific dataset can require many possible configurations and evaluations. In this work, we investigate whether a Vision-Language Model can instead visually evaluate clustering results and use those decisions to then tune an explicit clustering algorithm. We study this through three progressive experiments using Qwen3.5-27B and five controlled synthetic clustering scenarios. First, we test whether the VLM can distinguish the best clustering result from a pair of plots. Second, we test whether it can assign numerical scores to those plots where a higher score represents a better result. Finally, we use these judgments within an agentic loop in which the VLM scores a k-means clustering and proposes updated hyperparameters that may result in better clustering. Our exploratory results show that the VLM performs well when clear cluster structure is present, while struggling on more ambiguous and noisy settings. In the full agentic experiment, the VLM produces clustering configurations with silhouette scores relatively close to those of grid search and Bayesian optimization, while terminating in much fewer iterations. Overall, these results provide an initial proof of concept that VLM-based visual feedback can be used to autonomously tune an explicit clustering algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本文探索让视觉语言模型（VLM）通过“看”聚类可视化图来评价聚类质量，并以此驱动显式聚类算法（k-means）的超参数调优；结果显示VLM可作为视觉反馈信号在更少迭代内获得接近网格搜索与贝叶斯优化的轮廓系数。
AI.motivation: 聚类算法及其超参数的选择通常依赖大量候选配置与评估，成本高、搜索空间大。作者希望验证VLM能否替代或辅助传统数值指标，直接对聚类结果图做视觉判断，从而自动调参。
AI.method: 在Qwen3.5-27B与五个受控合成聚类场景上做三级递进实验：(1) 成对比较，判断两幅图中哪个聚类结果更好；(2) 给单幅图打数值分数，分数越高表示聚类越好；(3) 将打分嵌入代理循环（agentic loop），VLM对k-means结果评分并提出更新后的超参数。并与网格搜索、贝叶斯优化对照。
AI.result: 聚类结构清晰时VLM判断良好，在噪声大、结构模糊的场景中表现下降；完整代理实验中，VLM给出的聚类配置轮廓系数与网格搜索、贝叶斯优化较为接近，但迭代次数显著更少。
AI.conclusion: 结果构成初步概念验证：基于VLM的视觉反馈可用于自主调优显式聚类算法，具备替代部分昂贵数值搜索的潜力，但在模糊与噪声场景下仍不可靠。

title: Executable Archaeology: Reanimating the Logic Theorist
comment: This paper builds upon a previous ArXiv paper of a similar name: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2603.13514. This paper is NOT a mere rehash of the previous paper; appropriate citations and comparison are provided in the discussion. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: The Logic Theorist (LT), created by Allen Newell, J. C. Shaw, and Herbert Simon in 1955--1956, is regarded by some as the first artificial intelligence program. It was originally simulated by hand and written in a pseudocode called the Logic Language (LL), which was later called Information Processing Language One (IPL-I). LT was revised many times. The first machine-executed version was written in IPL-II and ran on the JOHNNIAC, and a late version was published in 1963 by Einar Stefferud as a pedagogical document and written in IPL-V, the only version of IPL that was formally released to the public. We describe a reanimation of both the IPL-I (LL) version of LT and the 1963 IPL-V version. Comparing the two reanimations illuminates the process of the invention of early AI algorithms and computer languages.

AI.tldr: 本文对Logic Theorist（LT）的两个版本——1955–1956年的IPL-I（LL）原始版本与1963年Stefferud以IPL-V编写的教学版本——进行了"复活"（reanimation）复现，并比较二者以揭示早期AI算法与计算机语言的发明过程。
AI.motivation: LT被部分学者视为第一个AI程序，但其原始实现历经多版改写（手写模拟→IPL-II/JOHNNIAC→IPL-V教学版），原始形态难以直接考察；作者希望通过复现不同版本，还原并理解早期AI算法与语言设计如何逐步成型。
AI.method: 对IPL-I（LL）版LT与1963年IPL-V版LT分别进行重新实现（reanimation），即在现代环境下复现两种原始描述所定义的LT行为，并对两次复现结果进行对比分析。
AI.result: 完成了两个版本的复现，并通过对二者的比较，呈现出早期AI算法的设计演变以及IPL系列语言（LL/IPL-I、IPL-II、IPL-V）的演进脉络。
AI.conclusion: 比较两个复现版本能够有效阐明早期AI算法与计算机语言的发明过程，说明"历史程序复现"是研究AI早期史的一种可行且有洞察力的方法。

title: Exact Sparse Assignment with Costly Target Embeddings: Fixed-Realization Certificates and an Empirical Audit
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Embedding-based one-to-one association is common in vision and data integration: detections are associated with tracks and records are linked across databases. Such pipelines often solve a sparse optional assignment whose edge scores add a cheap term to an inner product of neural embeddings. When target embeddings are costly, one can acquire them selectively and stop once a certificate proves that the current assignment is optimal. We give such a certificate for unit-norm embeddings. It bounds the unknown part of every reassignment by a support function and maximizes the resulting robust gains with a second sparse assignment; a shared owner-centred bound dominates any fixed-centre triangle bound. We make precise what is certified when network features are not batch-invariant: the realized values of the acquired rows and every unit-ball completion of the rest, not a second forward pass in a different batch. Auditing against a separately batched cache tests a different property; on our first pilot it produced a spurious $2.49\times10^{-6}$ objective failure. We audit the corrected protocol on four public text entity-matching benchmarks with two frozen encoders; no image data is used. All 96 certificate simulations and 120 online selective timings were exact on their own realization (largest objective gap $6.82\times10^{-13}$). At group size 8 the shared certificate acquires on average 60% of candidate-active targets, against 74% (mean centre), 69% (MEB) and 60% (zero centre): it beats the mean and MEB centres but not the zero centre, and savings concentrate in one benchmark (7% acquired). The prespecified runtime claim is contradicted: selective execution is +0.510 s slower per run (dataset-cluster 95% interval [+0.248, +0.772]). Uniform-microbatch re-encodings preserved the optimum in only 5 of 8 encoder-dataset cells, and 45 of 120 online runs disagreed with an eager cache at near-ties.

AI.tldr: 该文为基于视觉/数据集成中稀疏可选一对一分配的精确认证提出一种单位范数嵌入下的证书：用支撑函数界住每次重分配的未知部分，并以第二个稀疏分配最大化鲁棒增益。在四个文本实体匹配基准上，96 次证书模拟与 120 次在线选择性计时均精确，最大目标间隙 6.82×10⁻¹³；但预先设定的加速主张被否证，选择性执行每轮慢 0.510 s。
AI.motivation: 目标嵌入代价高昂，希望按需获取并一旦证书证明当前分配最优即停止；同时需厘清网络特征非批不变时证书究竟保证了什么，避免审计协议混淆不同性质。
AI.method: 针对单位范数嵌入构造证书：以支撑函数界定每次重分配的未知部分，用第二个稀疏分配最大化鲁棒增益；采用以单侧所有者为中心的共享界，优于任何固定中心三角界。明确认证对象为已获取行的实现值与其余行单位球内的所有补全，而非不同批次下的第二次前向；并以独立分批缓存作对照审计。
AI.result: 四个公开文本实体匹配基准、两个冻结编码器，未使用图像数据；96 次证书模拟与 120 次在线选择性计时在其自身实现上精确（最大目标间隙 6.82×10⁻¹³）。组大小 8 时共享证书平均获取 60% 候选活跃目标，对比均值中心 74%、MEB 69%、零中心 60%：优于均值与 MEB 中心但不及零中心，且节省集中于单一基准（获取 7%）。运行时主张被否证：选择性执行每轮慢 0.510 s（数据集簇 95% 区间 [+0.248, +0.772]）。均匀微批重编码仅在 8 个编码器-数据集单元中的 5 个保持最优；120 次在线运行中有 45 次在近似并列处与急切缓存不一致。
AI.conclusion: 共享所有者中心证书在单位范数嵌入下可给出严格的精确性保证，并优于均值与 MEB 中心，但相对零中心无优势；证书收益高度依赖数据集。非批不变性下，均匀微批重编码不可靠，急切缓存审计会误报（试点中出现 2.49×10⁻⁶ 的虚假目标失败），须采用与实现一致的认证协议，且选择性获取在当前实现下并不带来速度收益。

title: When Valid Decisions Are Not Enough: Evaluating Structural Constraints in Knowledge-Guided Generative Systems
summary:
Knowledge-guided generative systems use explicit domain constraints to improve decision consistency and alignment with human-created solutions. However, locally valid decisions do not necessarily preserve contextual relationships in human decision-making. This paper examines when structural constraints improve or degrade agreement with human reference solutions.
  We introduce HARMONIX, an experimental framework using automated musical harmonization as a controlled testbed for knowledge-guided decision-making. Four configurations share the same Viterbi-based optimization mechanism: a baseline, repetition constraints, functional constraints, and their combination. Experiments cover 19,745 records and 143,634 motif pairs across training and validation partitions.
  Combined constraints improve reference root-interval agreement by approximately five percentage points in stable structural contexts but reduce it by nearly nine percentage points in contexts involving transposition tracking. These opposing effects are consistent across both partitions, while overall exact chord agreement changes only marginally. Contexts are identified retrospectively using reference annotations; no adaptive constraint-selection mechanism is evaluated.
  The findings demonstrate that interpretable constraints can introduce systematic context-specific failures concealed by aggregate accuracy metrics. They highlight the need to evaluate relationships between decisions and the contextual applicability of constraints in knowledge-guided generative systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出HARMONIX框架，以自动化和声作为受控实验平台，检验显式结构约束何时提升或损害与人类参考解的一致性；结果显示约束效应依赖上下文，聚合指标会掩盖系统性失败。
AI.motivation: 知识引导生成系统常用显式领域约束提升决策一致性，但局部有效的决策未必保持人类决策中的上下文关系；作者希望厘清结构约束在何种情况下改善或削弱与人类参考解的一致性。
AI.method: 构建HARMONIX实验框架，以自动化和声为受控测试平台，四种配置共享同一Viterbi优化机制：基线、重复约束、功能约束及其组合；实验覆盖训练与验证分区共19,745条记录、143,634个动机对，上下文由参考标注回溯识别。
AI.result: 组合约束在稳定结构上下文中使参考根音程一致性提升约5个百分点，但在涉及移调跟踪的上下文中下降近9个百分点；该相反效应在两个分区一致，而整体精确和弦一致性仅边际变化。
AI.conclusion: 可解释约束会引入被聚合准确率掩盖的上下文相关系统性失败；知识引导生成系统需评估决策间关系及约束的上下文适用性，且本文未评估自适应约束选择机制。

title: Gradient-Guided Hardware-Native MIXFP4
summary: Blackwell tensor cores support native inference with 4-bit weights and activations (W4A4), but NVFP4 leaves a perplexity (PPL) gap to BF16. Choosing a format for each 16-element block can improve accuracy, but current matrix multiply instructions cannot execute choices this fine. Applying these rules at hardware-compatible tiles loses most of their benefit. We introduce FlipQuant, which selects E2M1 or E0M3 for each MMA weight tile. It keeps both quantized weight candidates fixed and learns a binary format map from end-to-end gradients of a bucketed KL loss to a BF16 teacher, re-evaluating them after each update. Native kernels execute 16 x 64 tiles on SM120 and 256 x 64 tiles on SM100 with median GEMM overheads of 1.9% and 1.7%, respectively. Across six language models and two corpora, FlipQuant at 16 x 64 closes 42.5% of NVFP4's PPL gap to BF16 on average, compared with 13.3% for FourOverSix. Code is available at https://github.com/brian030128/flipquant.

AI.tldr: FlipQuant：在硬件兼容的 MMA 权重 tile 粒度上，用可学习的二值格式映射在 E2M1 与 E0M3 之间逐 tile 选择 4-bit 量化格式，显著缩小 NVFP4 与 BF16 的困惑度差距且 GEMM 开销极低。
AI.motivation: Blackwell tensor core 原生支持 W4A4 推理，但 NVFP4 相对 BF16 仍有 PPL 差距。细粒度（每 16 元素一块）选择量化格式可提升精度，然而现有矩阵乘指令无法执行如此细的格式选择；把规则套用到硬件兼容的较大 tile 上会损失大部分收益。
AI.method: 对每个 MMA 权重 tile 在 E2M1 与 E0M3 两种量化格式间二选一：固定两份量化权重候选，以对 BF16 教师模型的、分桶 KL 损失的端到端梯度学习一张二值格式映射，并在每次更新后重新评估候选。原生 kernel 在 SM120 上执行 16×64 tile，在 SM100 上执行 256×64 tile。
AI.result: GEMM 中位开销分别为 1.9%（SM120）与 1.7%（SM100）。在 6 个语言模型、2 个语料上，16×64 配置的 FlipQuant 平均弥合 NVFP4 到 BF16 的 PPL 差距的 42.5%，而 FourOverSix 仅 13.3%。
AI.conclusion: 在硬件可执行的 tile 粒度上做数据驱动的格式选择，可有效回收细粒度量化格式决策的精度收益，同时保持近零的额外 GEMM 成本，为 Blackwell 上的 W4A4 推理提供实用改进。

title: When Does Confidence Reveal Problem Difficulty?
summary: While confidence signals are commonly evaluated for their ability to predict a model's own correctness, their relationship with problem difficulty remains less understood. In this work, we investigate a wide range of confidence-related signals and whether they can serve as indicators of problem difficulty across various task domains. We find that perturbation inconsistency, semantic entropy, and solution length exhibit strong associations with population difficulty than token-level uncertainty. Notably, these relationships persist even when restricting the analysis to problems correctly answered by the focal model, suggesting that such signals capture information about difficulty beyond their ability to predict the model's own correctness. We further explore applications of these signals, illustrating the potential and limitations of using confidence-related signals to guide inference-time decisions. Our findings highlight the utility of model-specific signals as imperfect but informative proxies for population-level problem difficulty.

AI.tldr: 本文系统考察多种置信度相关信号作为"问题难度"指标的可行性，发现扰动不一致性、语义熵与解答长度比token级不确定性更能反映群体难度，且该关联不依赖于模型自身答对与否。
AI.motivation: 置信度信号通常只被用来预测模型自身答案是否正确，而其与问题难度（群体层面难度）的关系尚不清楚。作者希望探究这些信号能否超出"自我正确性预测"的范畴，成为问题难度的代理指标，并用于推理阶段的决策。
AI.method: 在多种任务域中广泛采集置信度相关信号，并将其与群体难度进行关联分析；重点比较扰动不一致性、语义熵、解答长度与token级不确定性的相关性强度；进一步将分析限制在模型答对的样本上，以排除"自我正确性预测"这一混杂解释；最后探索这些信号在推理阶段决策中的应用及局限。
AI.result: 扰动不一致性、语义熵和解答长度与群体难度的关联显著强于token级不确定性；即使在仅考察模型正确作答的问题时，这些关联依然存在，说明信号捕捉到了超出自我正确性预测的难度信息；应用于推理阶段决策时既显示出潜力也存在局限。
AI.conclusion: 模型特定的置信度信号可作为群体层面问题难度的不完全但富有信息量的代理指标，拓展了置信度评估的传统用途。

title: Setting Optimal Reserve Prices using Fine-Tuned Language Models
summary: Online auction houses must set reserve prices for highly differentiated products whose unstructured descriptions contain valuable demand information. Existing approaches generally require managers to specify product attributes in advance. We ask whether a language model can instead learn from listing descriptions and historical bids to set item-specific reserve prices before bidding begins. We fine-tune a pretrained text embedding language model using the structural likelihood of auction bids as its training objective. This directs representation learning toward the valuation distribution that determines the reserve decision. We show that consecutive upper bids identify the tail information needed to set an optimal reserve without observing or modeling the number of potential bidders. A split-sample estimator learns the representation on one half of the data and conducts structural estimation and inference conditional on that representation on the other. We apply the method to approximately 65,800 online used-vehicle auctions. With seller values calibrated to match the sale rate among listings, the model implies a counterfactual net increase of $165.8 million, representing a 14.6% increase above the incumbent reserve policy. The framework translates a listing description and a seller's value into an item-specific reserve recommendation without constructing a product taxonomy or requiring a bid history for the item being priced. It provides an approach to adapting language models for operational decisions in marketplaces where products are heterogeneous and demand-relevant information is recorded in text.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用语言模型从在线拍卖的商品描述文本中学习需求信息，以贝叶斯拍卖结构似然为训练目标微调预训练文本嵌入模型，从而在竞拍开始前为差异化商品设定物品特定保留价（reserve price）。
AI.motivation: 在线拍卖行的商品高度异质，其非结构化描述文本包含有价值的支付意愿信息；现有方法需要管理者预先指定产品属性（构造产品分类体系），成本高且难以覆盖异质性。作者因此希望：能否让语言模型直接从挂牌描述与历史出价中学习，为每个物品设定保留价，而无需人工属性标注。
AI.method: （1）以拍卖出价的“结构似然”（structural likelihood）作为训练目标，微调预训练文本嵌入语言模型，使表征学习指向决定保留价决策的估值分布，而非一般语义相似度；（2）理论上表明，连续的最高出价（consecutive upper bids）即可识别设定最优保留价所需的尾部信息，无需观测或建模潜在竞标者数量；（3）采用分割样本（split-sample）估计量：一半数据学习文本表征，另一半在该表征条件下进行结构估计与推断，避免过拟合导致的推断偏误；（4）应用于约65,800条在线二手车拍卖数据，并将卖方价值校准至匹配实际成交率。
AI.result: 在该数据集上，模型隐含的反事实净收益增加1.658亿美元，较现行保留价政策提升14.6%。框架可将一段挂牌描述与卖方价值直接映射为物品特定的保留价建议，且无需为待定价物品提供出价历史。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型可通过结构目标微调，把文本中的需求信息转化为可操作的定价决策；该框架无需构建产品分类体系，也无需目标物品的出价历史，为商品异质、需求信息记录于文本的市场中的运营决策提供了可行路径。

title: What Moves a LoCoMo Score? Memory Context, Answer Prompts and Judges
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures. Answers, judge verdicts, human-check grades and scoring script: https://github.com/becos-ai/locomo-results
summary: LoCoMo is a widely reported benchmark for long-term conversational memory, but published scores mix memory quality with choices of answer prompt, judge and baseline layout that are rarely reported together. We measure how much these choices move a score, and evaluate Becos, a team memory system for coding agents, as a black box under all of them: ten conversations (1,540 questions), two answer models (gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4.1-mini), two answer prompts and three LLM judges, against a whole-conversation baseline rerun under identical conditions. Changing only the judge moves a score by up to 7.2 points and changing only the answer prompt by up to 9.3. A blind human check of 150 answers finds the judges reliable when they agree, and the primary judge's errors on disputed answers working against Becos rather than for it. Becos answers from a context with 90% fewer characters than the whole conversation. Its configuration was developed on LoCoMo itself, so there is no held-out set. With gpt-4o-mini answers it scores clearly higher than the whole conversation (79.7 vs 73.0 with the short prompt, paired 95% interval for the difference +3.8 to +9.5; 88.8 vs 77.5 with a step-by-step prompt). With gpt-4.1-mini answers the two score about the same (83.2 vs 83.1; 92.5 vs 92.1). We release every answer and verdict and the scoring script.

AI.tldr: LoCoMo上的记忆系统得分混杂了答案提示、评判模型与基线设置的影响；本文量化这些因素可致得分波动达7.2–9.3分，并在统一条件下以黑盒方式评测Becos，发现其仅在gpt-4o-mini下显著优于全对话上下文基线，在gpt-4.1-mini下两者持平。
AI.motivation: LoCoMo被广泛用于长程对话记忆评测，但公开分数将记忆质量与答案提示、评判模型及基线布局等评测选择相混杂，且这些选择很少被同时报告。作者希望先量化评测选择带来的分数漂移，再在此受控框架下重新评估一个编码智能体团队记忆系统Becos的真实性能。
AI.method: 在LoCoMo的10段对话（1,540个问题）上进行受控多因素实验：2个答案模型（gpt-4o-mini、gpt-4.1-mini）× 2种答案提示 × 3个LLM评判者，并将Becos作为黑盒在相同条件下与重跑的全对话基线比较；辅以150条答案的盲人工核验以检验评判者可靠性；同时报告Becos所用上下文长度（字符数比全对话少90%）。
AI.result: 仅更换评判者可使分数变动最多7.2分，仅更换答案提示可达9.3分。人工核查显示评判者在一致时可靠，且主评判者在争议题上的错误多不利于Becos。gpt-4o-mini下Becos显著优于全对话基线（短提示79.7 vs 73.0，配对95%区间+3.8至+9.5；分步提示88.8 vs 77.5）；gpt-4.1-mini下二者基本持平（83.2 vs 83.1；92.5 vs 92.1）。
AI.conclusion: LoCoMo分数对评判者与答案提示高度敏感，跨系统比较必须在统一评测配置下进行。在受控条件下，Becos以少90%字符的上下文仅在使用较弱答案模型时取得显著提升，强模型下与全对话基线相当；由于其配置在LoCoMo上开发、缺乏留出集，结论存在过拟合风险。作者公开全部答案、判定与评分脚本以支持可复现评测。

title: UbiHearo: Bringing Scenario-Aware Sound Guidance to DHH Users with Mobile Agents
summary: For Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing (DHH) users, effective sound awareness goes beyond detecting \emph{what} sound occurs; it requires understanding \emph{what it means}, \emph{how urgent it is}, and \emph{what to do}. However, existing mobile assistants largely reduce acoustic scenes to isolated labels or generic alerts, failing to provide contextual guidance when the same sound implies different risks across scenarios.
